translations.literal: Peng Yingcan, the circuit censor of Zhili, said: "The ancestral tombs may be judged free from immediate danger, and since we are presently occupied with eastern defenses against Japanese raids, river works should be suspended for now.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili circuit censor Peng Yingcan memorialized: "The ancestral tombs appear safe for the moment, and with eastern defenses against Japanese raids still active, river works ought to be suspended temporarily.

sentences.zh: 」部議令河臣熟計。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and ordered the river officials to consider carefully.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry ordered the river commissioners to weigh the matter carefully.

sentences.zh: 應龍、貞觀言：「為祖陵久遠計，支河實必不容已之工，請候明春倭警寧息舉行。

translations.literal: Yinglong and Zhenguan said: "For the long-term safety of the ancestral tombs, the branch canal is work that truly cannot be omitted; we ask that construction await next spring, when the Japanese alarm has quieted.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong and Zhenguan replied: "For the tombs' long-term protection, the branch canal is indispensable; we ask only that work wait until next spring, when the Japanese threat has eased.

sentences.zh: 」其事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was then shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The project was dropped.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春，貞觀報命，議開歸、徐達小河口，以救徐、邳之溢；

translations.literal: In the spring of year 21, Zhenguan reported back from his mission and proposed opening Xiahekou in Gui and Xu to relieve flooding in Xu and Pi;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Wanli 21, Zhang Zhenguan returned from his inspection and proposed opening Xiahekou in Gui and Xu to relieve flooding in Xu and Pi;

sentences.zh: 導濁河入小浮橋故道，以紓鎮口之患。

translations.literal: and channeling the muddy river into the old course at Xiaofuqiao to ease the distress at Zhenkou.
translations.idiomatic: and directing the muddy river into the old Xiaofuqiao channel to ease the crisis at Zhenkou.

sentences.zh: 下總河會官集議，未定。

translations.literal: The proposal was sent down for the grand canal officials to confer; no decision was reached.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was referred to the grand canal commissioners for joint deliberation, but no decision was made.

sentences.zh: 五月，大雨，河決單縣黃堌口，一由徐州出小浮橋，一由舊河達鎮口閘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, heavy rains caused the river to breach at Huangguhekou in Shanxian; one current exited through Xiaofuqiao via Xuzhou, another followed the old channel to the Zhenkou sluice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, torrential rains broke the river at Huangguhekou in Shanxian; one arm ran out through Xiaofuqiao at Xuzhou, the other down the old channel to the Zhenkou sluice.

sentences.zh: 邳城陷水中，高、寶諸湖堤決口無算。

translations.literal: Pizhou city sank under water, and countless breaches opened in the lake dikes of Gaoyou and Baoying.
translations.idiomatic: Pizhou city stood submerged, and the lake dikes of Gaoyou and Baoying opened in countless places.

sentences.zh: 明年，湖堤盡築塞，而黃水大漲，清口沙墊，淮水不能東下，於是挾上源阜陵諸湖與山溪之水，暴浸祖陵，泗城淹沒。

translations.literal: The following year, the lake dikes were all rebuilt and sealed, but Yellow River water rose sharply; sand piled up at Qingkou and Huai water could not flow east. Thereupon, carrying the waters of the upstream Funling lakes and mountain streams, it suddenly inundated the ancestral tombs and submerged Sizhou city.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the lake dikes were fully repaired, but the Yellow River rose sharply, sand piled at Qingkou, and the Huai could not run east. Carrying the upstream Funling lakes and mountain streams with it, the flood suddenly engulfed the ancestral tombs and drowned Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，又決高郵中堤及高家堰、高良澗，而水患益急矣。

translations.literal: In year 23, breaches again occurred at the middle dike of Gaoyou, Gaojia Weir, and Gaoliangjian, and the water crisis grew ever more acute.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 23 the middle dike at Gaoyou, Gaojia Weir, and Gaoliangjian broke again, and the water crisis grew worse.

sentences.zh: 先是，御史陳邦科言：「固堤束水未收刷沙之利，而反致沖決。

translations.literal: Previously, Censor Chen Bangke had said: "Fortifying dikes to confine the water fails to capture the benefit of scouring sand and instead causes breaches.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Censor Chen Bangke had argued: "Building dikes to pen the water gains no scouring benefit and only invites breaches.

sentences.zh: 法當用浚，其方有三。

translations.literal: The proper method is dredging; there are three approaches.
translations.idiomatic: The correct approach is dredging, and there are three methods.

sentences.zh: 冬春水涸，令沿河淺夫乘時撈淺，則沙不停而去，一也。

translations.literal: When winter and spring waters run low, have shallow-water laborers along the river seize the season to scoop shoals, so sand does not settle but departs—this is the first.
translations.idiomatic: First: in the low-water seasons of winter and spring, have shallow-water crews along the river dredge shoals in season so sand cannot settle.

sentences.zh: 官民船往來，船尾悉系鈀犁，乘風搜滌，則沙不寧而去，二也。

translations.literal: When official and private boats pass to and fro, attach rake-plows to every stern and, riding the wind, scour and wash, so sand cannot remain but departs—this is the second.
translations.idiomatic: Second: on passing official and private vessels, tie rake-plows to every stern and, using wind and current, scour the bed so sand cannot linger.

sentences.zh: 仿水磨、水碓之法，置為木機，乘水滾蕩，則沙不留而去，三也。

translations.literal: Following the method of water mills and water pestles, set up wooden machines to roll and churn with the current, so sand is not retained but departs—this is the third.
translations.idiomatic: Third: imitate water mills and stampers by installing wooden machines driven by the current to roll and wash sand away.

sentences.zh: 至淮必不可不會黃，故高堰斷不可棄。

translations.literal: When it comes to the Huai, it absolutely must join the Yellow; therefore Gaojia Weir must on no account be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai must ultimately meet the Yellow, so Gaojia Weir cannot be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 湖溢必傷堤，故周家橋潰處斷不可開。

translations.literal: When lakes overflow, the dikes are necessarily damaged; therefore the breached site at Zhoujia Bridge must on no account be opened.
translations.idiomatic: Lake overflow inevitably harms the dikes, so the breach at Zhoujia Bridge must not be opened.

sentences.zh: 已棄之道必淤滿，故老黃河、草灣等處斷不可。

translations.literal: Abandoned channels inevitably silt up full; therefore the Old Yellow River, Caowan, and the like must on no account be reopened.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoned channels inevitably silt full, so the Old Yellow River, Caowan, and similar routes must not be reopened.

sentences.zh: 」疏下所司議。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down for the responsible offices to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the relevant offices for discussion.

sentences.zh: 戶部郎中華存禮則請復黃河故道，並浚草灣。

translations.literal: Hua Cunli, director in the Ministry of Revenue, in contrast petitioned to restore the Yellow River's old course and also dredge Caowan.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Bureau Director Hua Cunli, by contrast, urged restoring the Yellow River's old course and dredging Caowan as well.

sentences.zh: 而是時腰鋪猶未開，工部侍郎沈節甫言：「復黃河未可輕議，至諸策皆第補偏救弊而已，宜概停罷。

translations.literal: At this time Yaopu had still not been opened. Vice Minister of Works Shen Jiefu said: "Restoring the Yellow River must not be lightly discussed; moreover, all these plans are merely patchwork remedies for partial failings—they should all be halted.
translations.idiomatic: Yaopu had still not been opened. Works Vice Minister Shen Jiefu argued: "Restoring the Yellow River must not be debated lightly; besides, these schemes are only stopgaps and ought all to be halted.

sentences.zh: 」乃召應龍還工部，時二十二年九月也。

translations.literal: Yinglong was then recalled to the Ministry of Works—this was in the ninth month of year 22.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong was recalled to the Ministry of Works—this was in the ninth month of Wanli 22.

sentences.zh: 既而給事中吳應明言：「先因黃河遷徙無常，設遙、縷二堤束水歸漕，及水過沙停，河身日高，徐、邳以下居民盡在水底。

translations.literal: Then Supervising Secretary Wu Yingming said: "Previously, because the Yellow River shifted its course without pattern, distant and thread dikes were built to confine the water for the grain route; as water passed and sand settled, the riverbed daily rose, and inhabitants below Xu and Pi all found themselves under water.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Wu Yingming then wrote: "Because the Yellow River shifted unpredictably, distant and thread dikes were built to confine it for the grain route; as water passed and sand settled, the channel rose daily until everyone below Xu and Pi lived under water.

sentences.zh: 今清口外則黃流阻遏，清口內則淤沙橫截，強河橫灌上流約百里許，淮水僅出沙上之浮流，而瀦蓄於盱、泗者遂為祖陵患矣。

translations.literal: Now outside Qingkou the Yellow current is obstructed; inside Qingkou silt bars the channel crosswise. The forceful river drives upstream across some hundred li; Huai water escapes only as surface flow atop the sand, while water backed up at Xuyi and Sizhou became the trouble at the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Yellow is blocked outside Qingkou and silt bars it within; the mighty river pushes upstream for roughly a hundred li, the Huai escapes only as surface flow over the sand, and water ponded at Xuyi and Sizhou threatens the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 張貞觀所議腰鋪支河歸之草灣，或從清河南岸別開小河至駱家營、馬廠等地，出會大河，建閘啟閉，一遇運淺，即行此河，亦策之便者。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhenguan's proposal of the Yaopu branch canal returning to Caowan, or alternatively opening a small channel from the south bank of the Qing section to Luojiaying, Machang, and elsewhere to rejoin the Great River with sluice gates for opening and closing—whenever the transport route shoals, this channel could be used—is likewise a convenient expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhenguan's plan for the Yaopu branch to Caowan, or a small cut from the south bank of the Qing reach to Luojiaying and Machang to rejoin the main stream with gated sluices for use whenever the transport channel shoaled, is likewise a practical option.

sentences.zh: 」至治泗水，則有議開老子山，引淮水入江者。

translations.literal: As for managing the Si River, some proposed opening Laozishan to draw Huai water into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: On managing the Si River, some proposed opening Laozishan to divert Huai water into the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 宜置閘以時啟閉，拆張福堤而堤清口，使河水無南向。

translations.literal: Sluice gates should be installed for timed opening and closing; the Zhangfu Embankment should be dismantled while Qingkou is diked, so river water cannot turn southward.
translations.idiomatic: Sluice gates should regulate flow by season; the Zhangfu Embankment should be cut back and Qingkou diked so river water cannot turn south.

sentences.zh: 部議下河漕諸臣會勘。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and sent the proposal down for the canal and river officials to survey jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry ordered the canal and river commissioners to inspect the plan jointly.

sentences.zh: 直隸巡按牛應元因謁祖陵，目擊河患，繪圖以進，因上疏言：

translations.literal: Niu Yingyuan, circuit censor of Zhili, having visited the ancestral tombs and witnessed the river disaster firsthand, submitted a diagram and memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Zhili circuit censor Niu Yingyuan, after visiting the ancestral tombs and seeing the flood damage himself, submitted a map and memorialized:

sentences.zh: 「黃高淮壅，起於嘉靖末年河臣鑿徐、呂二洪巨石，而沙日停，河身日高，潰決由此起。

translations.literal: The Yellow stands high and the Huai is choked—a condition arising from late Jiajing, when river officials cut away the giant boulders at the Xu and Lü shoals; sand daily accumulated and the riverbed daily rose, and breaches originated from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow stands high and the Huai is choked. This began in late Jiajing, when river officials cut the giant rocks at the Xu and Lü shoals; sand piled up daily, the channel rose daily, and breaches followed.

sentences.zh: 當事者計無復之，兩岸築長堤以束，曰縷堤。

translations.literal: Those in charge, finding no remedy, built long dikes on both banks to confine the water—these were called thread dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Finding no remedy, officials built long confining dikes on both banks—the thread dikes.

sentences.zh: 縷堤復決，更於數里外築重堤以防，曰遙堤。

translations.literal: When the thread dikes breached again, they built further dikes several li out as a second line of defense—these were called distant dikes.
translations.idiomatic: When the thread dikes failed again, they built outer dikes several li farther out—the distant dikes.

sentences.zh: 雖歲決歲補，而莫可誰何矣。

translations.literal: Though they breached year after year and were patched year after year, nothing could be done about it.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year they broke and were patched, yet nothing could be done.

sentences.zh: 黃、淮交會，本自清河北二十里駱家營，折而東至大河口會淮，所稱老黃河是也。

translations.literal: The Yellow and Huai originally met at the Old Yellow River twenty li north of the Qing section at Luojiaying, turning east to Dahekou to join the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow and Huai originally met along the Old Yellow River twenty li north of the Qing reach at Luojiaying, turning east to Dahekou to join the Huai.

sentences.zh: 陳瑄以其迂曲，從駱家營開一支河，為見今河道，而老黃河淤矣。

translations.literal: Chen Xuan, finding this route too winding, opened a branch canal from Luojiaying—today's main channel—and the Old Yellow River silted up.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Xuan, finding that route too winding, cut a branch from Luojiaying—the present main channel—and the Old Yellow River silted up.

sentences.zh: 萬曆間，復開草灣支河，黃舍故道而趨，以致清口交會之地，二水相持，淮不勝黃，則竄入各閘口，淮安士民於各閘口築一土埂以防之。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign, Caowan branch canal was reopened; the Yellow abandoned its old course and rushed elsewhere, so that at Qingkou where the two waters meet, they contended and the Huai could not prevail over the Yellow. It then forced its way into the various sluice mouths, and Huai'an officials and people built earthen barriers at each sluice mouth to guard against it.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wanli period the Caowan branch was reopened; the Yellow left its old bed and rushed off, so at Qingkou the two rivers collided, the Huai could not overcome the Yellow, and it forced into the sluice mouths—where Huai'an officials and people built earthen barriers at each gate.

sentences.zh: 嗣後黃、淮暴漲，水退沙停，清口遂淤，今稱門限沙是也。

translations.literal: Afterward, when the Yellow and Huai surged together and water receded while sand settled, Qingkou silted up—what is now called Threshold Sand.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the Yellow and Huai rose together and the water fell while sand remained, Qingkou silted—the bar now called Threshold Sand.

sentences.zh: 當事者不思挑門限沙，乃傍土埂築高堰，橫亙六十里，置全淮正流之口不事，復將從旁入黃之張福口一併築堤塞之，遂倒流而為泗陵患矣。

translations.literal: Those in charge, instead of dredging Threshold Sand, built Gaojia Weir alongside the earthen barriers, stretching sixty li across. They left untouched the main outlet of the full Huai current, then also diked and sealed Zhangfukou where water entered the Yellow from the side, so the river backed up and became a disaster for the Si tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Instead of dredging Threshold Sand, officials built Gaojia Weir beside the earthen barriers, a sixty-li barrier across the plain. They ignored the Huai's main outlet, then diked and sealed Zhangfukou where water entered the Yellow from the side, forcing the river back and threatening the Si tombs.

sentences.zh: 前歲，科臣貞觀議辟門限沙，裁張福堤，其所重又在支河腰鋪之開。

translations.literal: The year before, Supervising Secretary Zhenguan proposed clearing Threshold Sand and cutting back the Zhangfu Embankment, placing greatest weight on opening the Yaopu branch canal.
translations.idiomatic: The previous year, Supervising Secretary Zhenguan had proposed clearing Threshold Sand and trimming the Zhangfu Embankment, with greatest emphasis on opening the Yaopu branch.

sentences.zh: 總之，全口淤沙未盡挑辟，即腰鋪工成，淮水未能出也，況下流鮑、王諸口已決，難以施工。

translations.literal: In sum, until all silt at the full mouth is dredged and cleared, even if Yaopu works are completed the Huai cannot discharge; moreover, breaches have already opened downstream at Bao and Wang, making construction difficult.
translations.idiomatic: In short, until the mouth's sand is fully dredged, opening Yaopu will not let the Huai out—and downstream breaks at Baojia and Wangjia already make work there impossible.

sentences.zh: 豈若復黃河故道，盡辟清口淤沙之為要乎？

translations.literal: Would it not be more essential to restore the Old Yellow River course and fully clear Qingkou's silted sand?
translations.idiomatic: Would it not be better to restore the Old Yellow River and fully clear Qingkou's silt?

sentences.zh: 且疏上流，不若科臣應明所議，就草灣下流浚諸決口，俾由安東歸五港，或於周家橋量為疏通，而急塞黃堌口，挑蕭、碭管道，浚符離淺阻。

translations.literal: And as for dredging upstream, better than that is Supervising Secretary Yingming's proposal: dredge the breach openings downstream of Caowan so water returns to Wugang via Andong, or open Zhoujia Bridge as appropriate, while urgently sealing Huangguhekou, dredging the channels of Xiao and Dang, and clearing the shoals at Fuli.
translations.idiomatic: As for upstream dredging, Supervising Secretary Yingming's plan is better: dredge the breach mouths below Caowan so water returns to Wugang through Andong, or open Zhoujia Bridge as needed, while urgently sealing Huangguhekou, clearing the Xiao and Dang channels, and dredging the Fuli shoals.

sentences.zh: 至宿遷小河為淮水入黃正路，急宜挑辟，使有所歸。」

translations.literal: As for the small river at Suqian—the proper route for Huai water to enter the Yellow—it urgently needs dredging and opening so the water has somewhere to go.
translations.idiomatic: The small river at Suqian—the Huai's proper route into the Yellow—must be dredged and opened at once so the water has an outlet.

sentences.zh: 應龍言：「張福堤已決百餘丈，清口方挑沙，而腰鋪之開尤不可廢。

translations.literal: Yinglong said: "The Zhangfu Embankment has already breached over a hundred zhang; Qingkou is just being dredged for sand, and opening Yaopu especially must not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong replied: "The Zhangfu Embankment has already broken for more than a hundred zhang; Qingkou is only now being dredged, and the Yaopu opening must not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 」工部侍郎沈思孝因言：「老黃河自三義鎮至葉家沖僅八千餘丈，河形尚存。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Shen Sixiao added: "The Old Yellow River from Sanyizhen to Yejiachong is only a little over eight thousand zhang; the river's form still remains.
translations.idiomatic: Works Vice Minister Shen Sixiao added: "The Old Yellow River from Sanyizhen to Yejiachong is barely eight thousand zhang, and its bed still survives.

sentences.zh: 宜亟開浚，則河分為二，一從故道抵顏家河入海，一從清口會淮，患當自弭。

translations.literal: It should be opened and dredged at once; then the river would split in two—one following the old course to Yanjiahe and the sea, one joining the Huai at Qingkou—and the disaster should resolve itself.
translations.idiomatic: It should be opened and dredged immediately; the river would then divide in two—one arm down the old course to Yanjiahe and the sea, one joining the Huai at Qingkou—and the crisis should ease on its own.

sentences.zh: 請遣風力科臣一人，與河漕諸臣定畫一之計。

translations.literal: We ask that one vigorous supervising secretary be dispatched, together with the canal and river officials, to fix a single unified plan.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch one capable supervising secretary, together with the canal and river commissioners, to settle on one unified plan.

sentences.zh: 」乃命禮科給事中張企程往勘。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhang Qicheng of the Secretariat section was then ordered to go and survey.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhang Qicheng of the Secretariat section was ordered to inspect on site.

sentences.zh: 而以水患累年，迄無成畫，遷延糜費，罷應龍職為民，常居敬、張貞觀、彭應參等皆譴責有差。

translations.literal: Because the water disaster had dragged on for years with no settled plan, and delay had wasted funds, Yinglong was dismissed from office and reduced to commoner status; Chang Jujing, Zhang Zhenguan, Peng Yingcan, and others were all censured to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Because the flood crisis had dragged on for years without a settled plan, wasting funds in delay, Yinglong was dismissed and reduced to commoner status; Chang Jujing, Zhang Zhenguan, Peng Yingcan, and others were censured in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 御史高舉請「疏周家橋，裁張福堤，辟門限沙，建滾水石壩於周家橋、大小澗口、武家墩、綠楊溝上下，而壩外浚河築岸，使行地中。

translations.literal: Censor Gao Ju petitioned to "open Zhoujia Bridge, cut back the Zhangfu Embankment, and clear Threshold Sand; build overflow stone dams above and below Zhoujia Bridge, Daxiaojian Mouth, Wujiadun, and Lüyang Gou, dredging rivers and building banks outside the dams so channels run below ground level.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Gao Ju proposed opening Zhoujia Bridge, trimming the Zhangfu Embankment, and clearing Threshold Sand; building stone overflow dams above and below Zhoujia Bridge, Daxiaojian Mouth, Wujiadun, and Lüyang Gou, dredging channels and building banks outside the dams so the rivers run below grade.

sentences.zh: 改塘埂十二閘為壩，灌閘外十二河，以辟入海之路。

translations.literal: Convert the twelve Tang'geng sluices into dams and irrigate the twelve rivers outside the sluices to open paths to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the twelve Tang'geng sluices into dams and feed the twelve rivers outside them to open routes to the sea.

sentences.zh: 浚芒稻河，且多建濱江水閘，以廣入江之途。

translations.literal: Dredge the Mangdao River and build many sluice gates along the riverside to widen the route into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Dredge the Mangdao River and build more riverside sluice gates to widen the path into the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 然海口日壅，則河沙日積，河身日高，而淮亦不能安流。

translations.literal: Yet as the estuary daily silts up, river sand daily accumulates and the riverbed daily rises, and the Huai too cannot flow at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as the estuary chokes day by day, sand piles up, the channel rises, and the Huai too cannot run freely.

sentences.zh: 有灌口者，視諸口頗大，而近日所決蔣家、鮑家、畀家三口直與相射，宜挑浚成河，俾由此入海。

translations.literal: There is Guankou, rather larger than the other mouths; recently the three breaches at Jiangjia, Baojia, and Wangjia lie directly opposite it—it should be dredged into a full channel so water may reach the sea by this route.
translations.idiomatic: Guankou is larger than the other mouths, and the recent breaks at Jiangjia, Baojia, and Wangjia lie directly opposite; dredge a channel there so water can reach the sea by that route.

sentences.zh: 」工部主事樊兆程亦議辟海口，而言：「舊海口決不可浚，當自鮑家營至五港口挑浚成河，令從灌口入海。

translations.literal: Director Fan Zhaocheng of the Ministry of Works also proposed opening the estuary, saying: "The old estuary absolutely cannot be dredged; one should dredge a channel from Huangjiaying to Wugangkou and send water to sea through Guankou.
translations.idiomatic: Works Director Fan Zhaocheng also urged opening the estuary, arguing: "The old estuary cannot be dredged; cut a channel from Huangjiaying to Wugangkou and send the water to sea through Guankou.

sentences.zh: 」俱下工部。

translations.literal: Both proposals were sent down to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Both memorials were referred to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 請並委企程勘議。

translations.literal: They requested that Qicheng be entrusted to survey and deliberate on all of these together.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that Qicheng be assigned to inspect and evaluate all of these together.

sentences.zh: 是時，總河工部尚書楊一魁被論，乞罷，因言：「清口宜浚，黃河故道宜復，高堰不必修，石堤不必砌，減水閘壩不必用。

translations.literal: At this time Yang Yikui, Minister of Works and Grand Canal Director, came under impeachment and asked to resign, stating: "Qingkou should be dredged and the Old Yellow River course restored; Gaojia Weir need not be repaired, stone dikes need not be faced, and overflow sluice dams need not be used.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Grand Canal Director and Works Minister Yang Yikui, under attack in court, asked to resign, saying: "Qingkou should be dredged and the Old Yellow River restored; Gaojia Weir need not be rebuilt, stone dikes need not be faced, and overflow dams need not be used.

sentences.zh: 」帝不允辭，而詔以盡心任事。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not accept his resignation but ordered him to devote himself wholeheartedly to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused his resignation and ordered him to serve wholeheartedly.

sentences.zh: 御史夏之臣則言：「海口沙不可劈，草灣河不必浚，腰鋪新河四十里不必開，雲梯關不必辟，惟當急開高堰，以救祖陵。

translations.literal: Censor Xia Zhichen argued: "Estuarine sand cannot be split open; the Caowan canal need not be dredged; the forty-li new channel at Yaopu need not be opened; Yuntiguan need not be cleared—only Gaojia Weir should be opened urgently to rescue the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Xia Zhichen argued: "Estuarine sand cannot be cut through; the Caowan canal need not be dredged; the forty-li Yaopu cut need not be opened; Yuntiguan need not be cleared—only Gaojia Weir should be opened at once to save the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 」且言：「歷年以來，高良澗土堤每遇伏秋即沖決，大澗口石堤每遇洶湧即崩潰。

translations.literal: He further said: "Over the years, the earthen dikes at Gaoliangjian breach every midsummer and autumn flood season, and the stone dikes at Dajian Mouth collapse whenever waters surge.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "For years the earthen dikes at Gaoliangjian have broken every flood season, and the stone dikes at Dajian Mouth collapse whenever waters surge.

sentences.zh: 是高堰在，為高、寶之利小；

translations.literal: While Gaojia Weir stands, the benefit to Gaoyou and Baoying is small;
translations.idiomatic: While Gaojia Weir holds, Gaoyou and Baoying gain little;

sentences.zh: 而高堰決，則為高、寶之害大也。

translations.literal: but if Gaojia Weir fails, the harm to Gaoyou and Baoying is great.
translations.idiomatic: but if it fails, the harm to Gaoyou and Baoying is great.

sentences.zh: 孰若明議而明開之，使知趨避乎？

translations.literal: Would it not be better to debate openly and open it openly, so people know whether to flee or stay?
translations.idiomatic: Better to decide openly and breach openly, so people know whether to flee or stay.

sentences.zh: 」給事中黃運泰則又言：「黃河下流未泄，而遽開高堰、周橋以泄淮水，則淮流南下，黃必乘之，高、寶間盡為沼，而運道月河必沖決矣。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Huang Yuntai added: "If the lower Yellow River has not yet been discharged and one hastily opens Gaojia Weir and Zhouqiao to release Huai water, the Huai current will turn south and the Yellow will surely exploit it—the area between Gaoyou and Baoying will become marshland, and the transport route's moon canal will necessarily be breached.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Huang Yuntai added: "If the lower Yellow has not yet been discharged and Gaojia Weir and Zhoujia Bridge are opened hastily to release the Huai, the Huai will turn south and the Yellow will follow—the land between Gaoyou and Baoying will become marsh, and the transport moon canal will break.

sentences.zh: 不如浚五港口，達灌口門，以入於海之為得也。

translations.literal: Better to dredge Wugangkou, reach Guankou Gate, and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: It is better to dredge Wugangkou, reach Guankou Gate, and send the water to sea.

sentences.zh: 」詔並行勘議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all proposals to be surveyed and debated jointly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all plans to be inspected and debated together.

sentences.zh: 企程乃上言：「前此河不為陵患，自隆慶末年高、寶、淮、揚告急，當事狃於目前，清口既淤，又築高堰以遏之，堤張福以束之，障全淮之水與黃角勝，不虞其勢不敵也。

translations.literal: Qicheng then memorialized: "Previously the river did not threaten the tombs; since late Longqing, when Gaoyou, Baoying, Huai'an, and Yangzhou all cried emergency, officials clung to the present moment. After Qingkou silted up, they built Gaojia Weir to hold it back and diked Zhangfu to confine it, blocking the entire Huai to wrestle with the Yellow without foreseeing that its force could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Qicheng then wrote: "The river had not threatened the tombs before. Since late Longqing, when Gaoyou, Baoying, Huai'an, and Yangzhou all cried emergency, officials clung to short-term fixes. After Qingkou silted, they built Gaojia Weir to hold the Huai back and diked Zhangfu to confine it, penning the whole Huai to wrestle the Yellow without seeing that it could not win.

sentences.zh: 迨後甃石加築，堙塞愈堅，舉七十二溪之水匯於泗者，僅留數丈一口出之，出者什一，停者什九。

translations.literal: Later, as stone facing was added and construction reinforced, the blockage grew ever tighter. All waters of seventy-two streams gathering at Si were given only a few zhang-wide mouth to exit—one tenth discharged, nine tenths held back.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as stone facing and reinforcement piled up, the choke grew tighter. All seventy-two streams gathering at Si were given only a few zhang of outlet—one part out, nine parts held back.

sentences.zh: 河身日高，流日壅，淮日益不得出，而瀦蓄日益深，安得不倒流旁溢為泗陵患乎？

translations.literal: The riverbed daily rose, flow daily choked, the Huai daily less able to escape, and impounded water daily deeper—how could it not back up and spill aside to plague the Si tombs?
translations.idiomatic: The channel rose daily, flow choked daily, the Huai escaped less each day, and ponded water deepened—how could it not back up and spill aside to threaten the Si tombs?

sentences.zh: 今議疏淮以安陵，疏黃以導淮者，言人人殊。

translations.literal: Today those who debate draining the Huai to secure the tombs and draining the Yellow to guide the Huai speak each differently.
translations.idiomatic: Today everyone who speaks of draining the Huai to protect the tombs or draining the Yellow to guide the Huai says something different.

sentences.zh: 而謂高堰當決者，臣以為屏翰淮、揚，殆不可少。

translations.literal: Those who say Gaojia Weir should be breached—I believe as a bulwark for Huai'an and Yangzhou it can scarcely be done without.
translations.idiomatic: Those who say Gaojia Weir should be breached—I believe it is nearly indispensable as a shield for Huai'an and Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 莫若於其南五十里開周家橋注草子湖，大加開浚，一由金家灣入芒稻河注之江，一由子嬰溝入廣洋湖達之海，則淮水上流半有宣洩矣。

translations.literal: Better to open Zhoujia Bridge fifty li to its south, pouring into Caozi Lake with major dredging—one route from Jinjiawan into the Mangdao River to the Yangtze, one from Ziying Gou into Guangyang Lake to the sea—then half the upper Huai would have release.
translations.idiomatic: Better to open Zhoujia Bridge fifty li to the south into Caozi Lake with major dredging—one route from Jinjiawan through the Mangdao River to the Yangtze, one from Ziying Gou through Guangyang Lake to the sea—so half the upper Huai would have relief.

sentences.zh: 於其北十五里開武家墩，注永濟河，由窯灣閘出口直達涇河，從射陽湖入海，則淮水下流半有歸宿矣。

translations.literal: Fifteen li to its north, open Wujiadun, pouring into the Yongji River; exit through Yaowan Sluice straight to the Jing River and reach the sea via Sheyang Lake—then half the lower Huai would have an outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen li to the north, open Wujiadun into the Yongji River, exit through Yaowan Sluice to the Jing River and on through Sheyang Lake to the sea—so half the lower Huai would have an outlet.

sentences.zh: 此急救祖陵第一義也。

translations.literal: This is the first priority for urgently saving the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first urgent step to save the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 」會是時，祖陵積水稍退，一魁以聞，帝大悅，仍諭諸臣急協議宣洩。

translations.literal: Just then, standing water at the ancestral tombs had receded somewhat; Yikui reported this and the Emperor was greatly pleased, again instructing all officials to confer urgently on discharge.
translations.idiomatic: Just then standing water at the tombs had receded slightly; Yikui reported it, the emperor was greatly pleased, and again ordered the officials to agree urgently on discharge.

sentences.zh: 於是企程、一魁共議欲分殺黃流以縱淮，別疏海口以導黃。

translations.literal: Qicheng and Yikui jointly proposed splitting and reducing the Yellow current to free the Huai, and separately dredging the estuary to guide the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Qicheng and Yikui jointly proposed splitting the Yellow to ease the Huai and separately dredging the estuary to guide the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 而督漕尚書褚鈇則以江北歲祲，民不堪大役，欲先泄淮而徐議分黃。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Commissioner Chu Tie, however, citing famine years in northern Jiangsu and that the people could not bear great labor, wished first to release the Huai and defer discussion of splitting the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Commissioner Chu Tie, citing famine in northern Jiangsu and the people's inability to bear heavy labor, wanted to release the Huai first and defer splitting the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 御史應元折衷其說，言：「導淮勢便而功易，分黃功大而利遠。

translations.literal: Censor Yingyuan reconciled the views, saying: "Guiding the Huai is convenient in situation and easy in effort; splitting the Yellow is a large undertaking but with distant benefits.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yingyuan split the difference: "Guiding the Huai is geographically convenient and easier to accomplish; splitting the Yellow is a larger task but with more distant benefits.

sentences.zh: 顧河臣所請亦第六十八萬金，國家亦何靳於此？

translations.literal: Yet the river officials' request is only 680,000 taels of silver—why should the state be niggardly here?
translations.idiomatic: The river commissioners ask for only 680,000 taels—why should the state stint here?

sentences.zh: 」御史陳煃嘗令寶應，慮周家橋既開，則以高郵、邵伯為壑，運道、民產、鹽場交受其害，上疏爭之，語甚激，大旨分黃為先，而淮不必深治。

translations.literal: Censor Chen Chao, who had once served as magistrate of Baoying, feared that if Zhoujia Bridge were opened, Gaoyou and Shaobo would become sacrifice zones—transport routes, private property, and salt fields would all suffer together. He memorialized in vehement protest; his main point was that splitting the Yellow should come first, while the Huai need not be deeply treated.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Chen Chao, who had once governed Baoying, feared that opening Zhoujia Bridge would make Gaoyou and Shaobo the sacrifice zone—transport routes, private property, and salt fields would all suffer. He memorialized in fierce protest, arguing that splitting the Yellow should come first and the Huai need not be deeply treated.

sentences.zh: 且欲多開入海之路，令高、寶諸湖之水皆東，而後周家橋、武家墩之水可注。

translations.literal: He moreover wished to open many routes to the sea so waters of the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes all flowed east, and only then could water from Zhoujia Bridge and Wujiadun be discharged into them.
translations.idiomatic: He also wanted many routes to the sea opened so the waters of Gaoyou and Baoying lakes could all run east, and only then could water from Zhoujia Bridge and Wujiadun be poured in.

sentences.zh: 而淮安知府馬化龍復進分黃五難之說。

translations.literal: Huai'an Prefect Ma Hualong further advanced his "five difficulties" argument against splitting the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an Prefect Ma Hualong then submitted his argument on the five difficulties of splitting the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 潁州兵備道李弘道又謂宜開高堰。

translations.literal: Yingzhou Military Preparedness Commissioner Li Hongdao also said the Gaoya Weir should be opened.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou military preparedness commissioner Li Hongdao also argued that the Gaoya Weir should be opened.

sentences.zh: 鈇遂據以上聞。

translations.literal: Tie thereupon submitted a memorial on these points to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Tie thereupon memorialized the throne citing these views.

sentences.zh: 給事中林熙春駁之，言：「淮猶昔日之淮，而河非昔日之河，先是河身未高，而淮尚安流，今則河身既高，而淮受倒灌，此導淮固以為淮，分黃亦以為淮。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Lin Xichun rebutted him, saying: "The Huai is still the Huai of old, but the river is no longer the river of old. Formerly the river bed was not yet high and the Huai still flowed peacefully; now the river bed has risen and the Huai suffers backflow. Guiding the Huai is indeed for the Huai's sake, and splitting the Yellow is also for the Huai's sake.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Lin Xichun rebutted him, saying: "The Huai is still the Huai of old, but the river is no longer the river of old. Formerly the river bed was not yet high and the Huai still flowed at ease; now the river bed has risen and the Huai suffers backflow. Guiding the Huai is truly for the Huai's sake, and splitting the Yellow is likewise for the Huai's sake.

sentences.zh: 」工部乃覆奏云：「先議開腰鋪支河以分黃流，以倭儆、災傷停寢，遂貽今日之患。

translations.literal: " The Works Ministry replied in memorial: "The earlier plan to open the Yaopu branch to split the Yellow flow was suspended because of the Japanese alarm and disaster relief, and thus today's calamity was bequeathed.
translations.idiomatic: " The Works Ministry replied in memorial: "The earlier plan to open the Yaopu branch river to split the Yellow flow was suspended because of the Japanese alarm and disaster relief, and thus bequeathed today's calamity.

sentences.zh: 今黃家壩分黃之工若復沮格，淮壅為害，誰職其咎？

translations.literal: If the Huangjia Dam project to split the Yellow is again obstructed and the Huai is dammed to harm, who will bear the blame?
translations.idiomatic: If work to split the Yellow at Huangjia Dam is again obstructed and the Huai is dammed to the point of harm, who will bear the blame?

sentences.zh: 請令治河諸臣導淮分黃，亟行興舉。

translations.literal: We ask that the officials charged with river control be ordered to guide the Huai and split the Yellow and to launch the work at once.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the officials charged with river control be ordered to guide the Huai and split the Yellow and to launch the work at once.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十四年八月，一魁興工未竣，復條上分淮導黃事宜十事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, before Yikui's project was finished, he again submitted ten items on guiding the Huai and conducting the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, before Yikui's project was finished, he again submitted ten items on matters of guiding the Huai and conducting the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 十月，河工告成，直隸巡按御史蔣春芳以聞，復條上善後事宜十六事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the river works were reported complete; Zhili investigating censor Jiang Chunfang memorialized the fact and again submitted sixteen items on follow-up measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the river works were reported complete; Zhili investigating censor Jiang Chunfang memorialized the fact and again submitted sixteen items on follow-up measures.

sentences.zh: 乃賞賚一魁等有差。

translations.literal: Rewards and gifts were then bestowed on Yikui and others in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and gifts were then bestowed on Yikui and others in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 是役也，役夫二十萬，開桃源黃河壩新河，起黃家嘴，至安東五港、灌口，長三百餘里，分泄黃水入海，以抑黃強。

translations.literal: In this undertaking two hundred thousand laborers opened the new channel at the Taoyuan Yellow River dam, from Huangjiazui to Andong's five ports and Guankou—a length of more than three hundred li—to divide and discharge Yellow water into the sea and curb the Yellow's strength.
translations.idiomatic: In this undertaking two hundred thousand laborers opened the new channel at the Taoyuan Yellow River dam, from Huangjiazui to Andong's five ports and Guankou—a length of more than three hundred li—to divide and discharge Yellow water into the sea and curb the Yellow's strength.

sentences.zh: 辟清口沙七里，建武家墩、高良澗、周家橋石閘，泄淮水三道入海，且引其支流入江。

translations.literal: Seven li of sand at Qingkou were cleared; stone sluices were built at Wujiadun, Gaoliangjian, and Zhoujia Bridge to discharge Huai water in three routes to the sea, and branch flows were also led into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Seven li of sand at Qingkou were cleared; stone sluices were built at Wujiadun, Gaoliangjian, and Zhoujia Bridge to discharge Huai water in three routes to the sea, and branch flows were also led into the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 於是泗陵水患平，而淮、揚安矣。

translations.literal: Thus the water calamity at Siling was settled, and Huai and Yang were secure.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the water calamity at Siling was settled, and Huai and Yang were secure.

sentences.zh: 然是時一魁專力桃、清、淮、泗間，而上流單縣黃堌口之決，以為不必塞。

translations.literal: Yet at this time Yikui concentrated his effort between Taoyuan, Qing, Huai, and Si, while regarding the breach at Huangguhekou upstream in Shan County as not needing to be sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at this time Yikui concentrated his effort between Taoyuan, Qing, Huai, and Si, while holding that the breach at Huangguhekou upstream in Shan County need not be sealed.

sentences.zh: 鈇及春芳皆請塞之。

translations.literal: Both Tie and Chunfang asked that it be sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Both Tie and Chunfang asked that it be sealed.

sentences.zh: 給事中李應策言：「漕臣主運，河臣主工，各自為見。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Li Yingce said: "The canal commissioner is master of transport and the river commissioner is master of works; each holds his own view.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Li Yingce said: "The canal commissioner is master of transport and the river commissioner is master of works; each holds his own view.

sentences.zh: 宜再令析議。

translations.literal: They should again be ordered to debate and decide separately.
translations.idiomatic: They should again be ordered to debate and decide separately.

sentences.zh: 」一魁言：「黃堌口一支由虞城、夏邑接碭山、蕭縣、宿州至宿遷，出白洋河，一小支分蕭縣兩河口，出徐州小浮橋，相距不滿四十里。

translations.literal: " Yikui said: "One arm from Huangguhekou runs through Yucheng and Xiayi, connecting Dangshan, Xiaoxian, Suzhou, and Suqian, and exits at Baiyang River; a small branch splits at Xiaoxian's Lianghekou and exits at Xuzhou's Xiaofuqiao, the two less than forty li apart.
translations.idiomatic: " Yikui said: "One arm from Huangguhekou runs through Yucheng and Xiayi, connecting Dangshan, Xiaoxian, Suzhou, and Suqian, and exits at Baiyang River; a small branch splits at Xiaoxian's Lianghekou and exits at Xuzhou's Xiaofuqiao, the two less than forty li apart.

sentences.zh: 當疏浚與正河會，更通鎮口閘裏湖之水，與小浮橋二水會，則黃堌口不必塞，而運道無滯矣。

translations.literal: They should be dredged to meet the main channel, and the water of Zhenkou Sluice's inner lake should further be connected so that it joins the two waters at Xiaofuqiao; then Huangguhekou need not be sealed and the transport route will not be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: They should be dredged to meet the main channel, and the water of Zhenkou Sluice's inner lake should further be connected so that it joins the two waters at Xiaofuqiao; then Huangguhekou need not be sealed and the transport route will not be blocked.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 於是議浚小浮橋、沂河口、小河口以濟徐、邳運道，以泄碭、蕭漫流，掊歸仁堤以護陵寢。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was proposed to dredge Xiaofuqiao, the Yi River mouth, and the Xiao River mouth to aid the Xu and Pi transport route, to discharge the overflow of Dang and Xiao, and to cut the Guiren Embankment to protect the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon it was proposed to dredge Xiaofuqiao, the Yi River mouth, and the Xiao River mouth to aid the Xu and Pi transport route, to discharge the overflow of Dang and Xiao, and to cut the Guiren Embankment to protect the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 是時，徐、邳復見清、泗運道不利，鈇終以為憂。

translations.literal: At this time Xu and Pi again saw the Qing and Si transport route impaired, and Tie remained anxious.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Xu and Pi again saw the Qing and Si transport route impaired, and Tie remained anxious.

sentences.zh: 二十五年正月，復極言黃堌口不塞，則全河南徙，害且立見。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fifth year he again spoke urgently that if Huangguhekou were not sealed the whole Yellow River would shift course and the harm would appear at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fifth year he again spoke urgently that if Huangguhekou were not sealed the whole Yellow River would shift course and the harm would appear at once.

sentences.zh: 議者亦多恐下齧歸仁，為二陵患。

translations.literal: Many in the debate also feared that downstream erosion at Guiren would threaten the two tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Many in the debate also feared that downstream erosion at Guiren would threaten the two tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月，小浮橋等口工垂竣，一魁言：

translations.literal: In the third month, as work at Xiaofuqiao and the other mouths neared completion, Yikui said:
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, as work at Xiaofuqiao and the other mouths neared completion, Yikui said:

sentences.zh: 「運道通利，河徙不相妨，已有明驗。

translations.literal: "The transport route is open and smooth and river migration does not interfere—there is already clear proof.
translations.idiomatic: "The transport route is open and smooth and river migration does not interfere—there is already clear proof.

sentences.zh: 惟議者以祖陵為慮，請徵往事折之。

translations.literal: Only because debaters worry for the ancestral tombs, let past events be cited to refute them.
translations.idiomatic: Only because debaters worry for the ancestral tombs, let past events be cited to refute them.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十四年，河決原武，東南至壽州入淮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Hongwu the river breached at Yuanwu and flowed southeast to Shouzhou to enter the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Hongwu the river breached at Yuanwu and flowed southeast to Shouzhou to enter the Huai.

sentences.zh: 永樂九年，河北入魚臺。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongle it moved north to enter Yutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Yongle it moved north to enter Yutai.

sentences.zh: 未幾復南決，由渦河經懷遠入淮。

translations.literal: Before long it breached south again, passing through the Wo River via Huaiyuan to enter the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Before long it breached south again, passing through the Wo River via Huaiyuan to enter the Huai.

sentences.zh: 時兩河合流，曆鳳、泗以出清口，未聞為祖陵患。

translations.literal: At that time the two rivers joined and passed Feng and Si to exit at Qingkou; no one heard of harm to the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the two rivers joined and passed Feng and Si to exit at Qingkou; no one heard of harm to the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 正統十三年，河北沖張秋。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhengtong the river burst north at Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Zhengtong the river burst north at Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 景泰中，徐有貞塞之，復由渦河入淮。

translations.literal: In the Jingtai period Xu Youzhen sealed it, and it again entered the Huai via the Wo River.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingtai period Xu Youzhen sealed it, and it again entered the Huai via the Wo River.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，河又北沖，白昂、劉大夏塞之，復南流，一由中牟至潁、壽，一由亳州至渦河入淮，一由宿遷小河口會泗。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongzhi the river burst north again; Bai Ang and Liu Daxia sealed it and it flowed south again—one route from Zhongmou to Ying and Shou, one from Bozhou to the Wo River to enter the Huai, and one from Suqian's Xiaohekou to join Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongzhi the river burst north again; Bai Ang and Liu Daxia sealed it and it flowed south again—one route from Zhongmou to Ying and Shou, one from Bozhou to the Wo River to enter the Huai, and one from Suqian's Xiaohekou to join Si.

sentences.zh: 全河大勢縱橫潁、亳、鳳、泗間，下溢符離、睢、宿，未聞為祖陵慮，亦不聞堤及歸仁也。

translations.literal: The whole river's main tendency ran across Ying, Bo, Feng, and Si; downstream it overflowed at Fuli, Sui, and Su—yet no one heard of concern for the ancestral tombs, nor of diking at Guiren.
translations.idiomatic: The whole river's main tendency ran across Ying, Bo, Feng, and Si; downstream it overflowed at Fuli, Sui, and Su—yet no one heard of concern for the ancestral tombs, nor of diking at Guiren.

sentences.zh: 正德三年後，河漸北徙，由小浮橋、飛雲橋、穀亭三道入漕，盡趨徐、邳，出二洪，運道雖濟，而泛溢實甚。

translations.literal: After the third year of Zhengde the river gradually shifted north, entering the canal via Xiaofuqiao, Feiyun Bridge, and Guting in three routes, all rushing toward Xu and Pi and out through the Two Rapids; though the transport route was aided, flooding was in fact severe.
translations.idiomatic: After the third year of Zhengde the river gradually shifted north, entering the canal via Xiaofuqiao, Feiyun Bridge, and Guting in three routes, all rushing toward Xu and Pi and out through the Two Rapids; though the transport route was aided, flooding was in fact severe.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年，硃裳始有渦河一支中經鳳陽祖陵未敢輕舉之說。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Jiajing Zhu Shang first voiced the view that a Wo River branch passing through the Fengyang ancestral tombs could not be lightly attempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Jiajing Zhu Shang first voiced the view that a Wo River branch passing through the Fengyang ancestral tombs could not be lightly attempted.

sentences.zh: 然當時猶時浚祥符之董盆口、寧陵之五里鋪、滎澤之孫家渡、蘭陽之趙皮寨，又或決睢州之地丘店、界牌口、野雞岡，寧陵之楊村鋪，俱入舊河，從亳、鳳入淮，南流未絕，亦何嘗為祖陵患？

translations.literal: Yet at that time they still sometimes dredged Dongpenkou at Xiangfu, Wulipu at Ningling, Sunjiadu at Xingze, and Zhaopizhai at Lanyang, or breached Diqiudian, Jiepaikou, and Yejigang at Suizhou, Yangcunpu at Ningling—all entering the old river and from Bo and Feng entering the Huai; the southern flow was not cut off—when had it ever harmed the ancestral tombs?
translations.idiomatic: Yet at that time they still sometimes dredged Dongpenkou at Xiangfu, Wulipu at Ningling, Sunjiadu at Xingze, and Zhaopizhai at Lanyang, or breached Diqiudian, Jiepaikou, and Yejigang at Suizhou, Yangcunpu at Ningling—all entering the old river and from Bo and Feng entering the Huai; the southern flow was not cut off—when had it ever harmed the ancestral tombs?

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十五年後，南流故道始盡塞，或由秦溝入漕，或由濁河入漕。

translations.literal: After the twenty-fifth year of Jiajing the old southern channels were finally all blocked, or entered the canal via Qingou, or via the Zhuo River.
translations.idiomatic: After the twenty-fifth year of Jiajing the old southern channels were finally all blocked, or entered the canal via Qingou, or via the Zhuo River.

sentences.zh: 五十年來全河盡出徐、邳，奪泗入淮。

translations.literal: For fifty years the whole river exited only at Xu and Pi, seizing Si to enter the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: For fifty years the whole river exited only at Xu and Pi, seizing Si to enter the Huai.

sentences.zh: 而當事者方認客作主，日築堤而窘之，以致河流日壅，淮不敵黃，退而內瀦，遂貽盱、泗祖陵之患。

translations.literal: Meanwhile those in charge treated the guest as master, day by day building dikes to confine it, so the river daily silted, the Huai could not match the Yellow, retreated and ponded inward, and thus bequeathed calamity to the tombs at Xu and Si.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile those in charge treated the guest as master, day by day building dikes to confine it, so the river daily silted, the Huai could not match the Yellow, retreated and ponded inward, and thus bequeathed calamity to the tombs at Xu and Si.

sentences.zh: 此實由內水之停壅，不由外水之沖射也。

translations.literal: This was truly because inner waters stagnated and dammed, not because outer waters struck and shot.
translations.idiomatic: This was truly because inner waters stagnated and dammed, not because outer waters struck and shot.

sentences.zh: 萬曆七年，潘季馴始慮黃流倒灌小河、白洋等口，挾諸河水沖射祖陵，乃作歸仁堤為保障計，復張大其說，謂祖陵命脈全賴此堤。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Wanli Pan Jixun first feared Yellow backflow at the Xiao River, Baiyang, and other mouths, carrying various river waters to strike the ancestral tombs; he therefore built the Guiren Embankment as a safeguard and again exaggerated the claim that the ancestral tombs' life-line wholly depended on this dike.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Wanli Pan Jixun first feared Yellow backflow at the Xiao River, Baiyang, and other mouths, carrying various river waters to strike the ancestral tombs; he therefore built the Guiren Embankment as a safeguard and again exaggerated the claim that the ancestral tombs' life-line wholly depended on this dike.

sentences.zh: 習聞其說者，遂疑黃堌之決，下齧歸仁，不知黃堌一決，下流易泄，必無上灌之虞。

translations.literal: Those accustomed to hear this view then suspected that the Huanggu breach would erode Guiren downstream, not knowing that once Huanggu breached, downstream discharge would be easy and there would certainly be no fear of upward flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Those accustomed to hear this view then suspected that the Huanggu breach would erode Guiren downstream, not knowing that once Huanggu breached, downstream discharge would be easy and there would certainly be no fear of upward flooding.

sentences.zh: 況今小河不日竣工，引河復歸故道，雲歸仁益遠，奚煩過計為？

translations.literal: Moreover the small river will soon be completed and the diverted river will return to its old course; Guiren will be even farther away—why fuss with excessive worry?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the small river will soon be completed and the diverted river will return to its old course; Guiren will be even farther away—why fuss with excessive worry?

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 一魁既開小浮橋，築義安山，浚小河口，引武沂泉濟運。

translations.literal: Yikui had opened Xiaofuqiao, built Yi'an Mountain, dredged the Xiao River mouth, and led Wuyi springs to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: Yikui had opened Xiaofuqiao, built Yi'an Mountain, dredged the Xiao River mouth, and led Wuyi springs to aid transport.

sentences.zh: 及是年四月，河復大決黃堌口，溢夏邑、永城，由宿州府離橋出宿遷新河口入大河，其半由徐州入舊河濟運。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year the river again breached greatly at Huangguhekou, flooding Xiayi and Yongcheng, passing Suzhou's Fuliqiao to exit at Suqian's new river mouth into the great river; half entered the old river at Xuzhou to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year the river again breached greatly at Huangguhekou, flooding Xiayi and Yongcheng, passing Suzhou's Fuliqiao to exit at Suqian's new river mouth into the great river; half entered the old river at Xuzhou to aid transport.

sentences.zh: 上源水枯，而義安束水橫壩復沖二十餘丈，小浮橋水脈微細，二洪告涸，運道阻澀。

translations.literal: Upstream sources ran dry, and the Yi'an barrier dam that held back water was again breached for more than twenty zhang; the Xiaofuqiao water course grew fine, the Two Rapids reported dry, and the transport route was blocked and sluggish.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream sources ran dry, and the Yi'an barrier dam that held back water was again breached for more than twenty zhang; the Xiaofuqiao water course grew fine, the Two Rapids reported dry, and the transport route was blocked and sluggish.

sentences.zh: 一魁因議挑黃堌口迤上埽灣、淤嘴二處，且大挑其下李吉口北下濁河，救小浮橋上流數十里之涸。

translations.literal: Yikui therefore proposed dredging upstream at Huangguhekou at Saowan and Yuzui, and greatly dredging the Zhuo River below Lijikou to the north to save the dozens of li of dryness above Xiaofuqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Yikui therefore proposed dredging upstream at Huangguhekou at Saowan and Yuzui, and greatly dredging the Zhuo River below Lijikou to the north to save the dozens of li of dryness above Xiaofuqiao.

sentences.zh: 復上言：「黃河南旋至韓家道、盤岔河、丁家莊，俱岸闊百丈，深逾二丈，乃銅幫鐵底故道也。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "The Yellow turns south to Hanjiadao, Pancahe, and Dingjiazhuang—all banks a hundred zhang wide and more than two zhang deep—the old channel with copper banks and iron bottom.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized: "The Yellow turns south to Hanjiadao, Pancahe, and Dingjiazhuang—all banks a hundred zhang wide and more than two zhang deep—the old channel with copper banks and iron bottom.

sentences.zh: 至劉家ＡＨ，始強半南流，得山西坡、永涸湖以為壑，出溪口入符離河，亦故道也。

translations.literal: At Liu's bend it begins to flow mostly south, gaining Xishanpo and Yonghu Lake as basins and exiting at Xikou to enter the Fuli River—also an old channel.
translations.idiomatic: At Liu's bend it begins to flow mostly south, gaining Xishanpo and Yonghu Lake as basins and exiting at Xikou to enter the Fuli River—also an old channel.

sentences.zh: 惟徐、邳運道淺涸，所以首議開小浮橋，再加挑辟，必大為運道之利。

translations.literal: Only the Xu and Pi transport route is shallow and dry; that is why opening Xiaofuqiao was first debated, and further dredging will surely greatly benefit the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Xu and Pi transport route is shallow and dry; that is why opening Xiaofuqiao was first debated, and further dredging will surely greatly benefit the transport route.

sentences.zh: 乃欲自黃堌挽回全河，必須挑四百里淤高之河身，築三百里南岸之長堤，不惟所費不貲，竊恐後患無已。

translations.literal: Yet to turn the whole river back from Huanggu would require dredging four hundred li of silted-high river bed and building three hundred li of long dikes on the south bank—not only would the cost be beyond reckoning; I fear endless trouble afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Yet to turn the whole river back from Huanggu would require dredging four hundred li of silted-high river bed and building three hundred li of long dikes on the south bank—not only would the cost be beyond reckoning; I fear endless trouble afterward.

sentences.zh: 」御史楊光訓等亦議挑埽灣直渠，展濟濁河，及築山西坡歸仁堤，與一魁合，獨鈇異議。

translations.literal: Censor Yang Guangxun and others also proposed dredging a straight channel at Saowan, extending the Zhuo River, and building the Xishanpo Guiren Embankment, agreeing with Yikui; only Tie differed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yang Guangxun and others also proposed dredging a straight channel at Saowan, extending the Zhuo River, and building the Xishanpo Guiren Embankment, agreeing with Yikui; only Tie differed.

sentences.zh: 帝命從一魁言。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that Yikui's view be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that Yikui's view be followed.

sentences.zh: 一魁復言：「歸仁在西北，泗州在東南，相距百九十里，中隔重岡疊嶂。

translations.literal: Yikui again said: "Guiren lies to the northwest and Sizhou to the southeast, a hundred ninety li apart with heavy ridges and layered peaks between.
translations.idiomatic: Yikui again said: "Guiren lies to the northwest and Sizhou to the southeast, a hundred ninety li apart with heavy ridges and layered peaks between.

sentences.zh: 且歸仁之北有白洋河、硃家溝、周家溝、胡家溝、小河口泄入運河，勢如建瓴，即無歸仁，祖陵無足慮。

translations.literal: North of Guiren are Baiyang River, Zhujiagou, Zhoujiagou, Hujiagou, and the Xiao River mouth discharging into the canal—the force like water poured from a high jar; even without Guiren the ancestral tombs need not be worried over.
translations.idiomatic: North of Guiren are Baiyang River, Zhujiagou, Zhoujiagou, Hujiagou, and the Xiao River mouth discharging into the canal—the force like water poured from a high jar; even without Guiren the ancestral tombs need not be worried over.

sentences.zh: 濁河淤墊，高出地上，曹、單間闊一二百丈，深二三丈，尚不免橫流，徐、邳間僅百丈，深止丈餘，徐西有淺至二三尺者，而夏、永、韓家道口至符離，河闊深視曹、單，避高就下，水之本性，河流所棄，自古難復。

translations.literal: The Zhuo River is silted and piled higher than the ground; between Cao and Shan the width is one or two hundred zhang and depth two or three zhang, yet overflow cannot be avoided; between Xu and Pi it is only a hundred zhang and depth barely more than one zhang, and west of Xu there are shallows of only two or three chi; yet from Xia, Yong, and Hanjiadao to Fuli the river is wider and deeper than at Cao and Shan—seeking low from high is water's nature; what the river abandons has been hard to restore since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuo River is silted and piled higher than the ground; between Cao and Shan the width is one or two hundred zhang and depth two or three zhang, yet overflow cannot be avoided; between Xu and Pi it is only a hundred zhang and depth barely more than one zhang, and west of Xu there are shallows of only two or three chi; yet from Xia, Yong, and Hanjiadao to Fuli the river is wider and deeper than at Cao and Shan—seeking low from high is water's nature; what the river abandons has been hard to restore since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 且運河本籍山東諸泉，不資黃水，惟當仿正統間二洪南北口建閘之制，於鎮口之下，大浮橋之上，呂梁之下洪，邳州之沙坊，各建石閘，節宣汶、泗，而以小浮橋、沂河口二水助之，更於鎮口西築壩截黃，開唐家口而注之龍溝，會小浮橋入運，以杜灌淤鎮口之害，實萬全計也。

translations.literal: Moreover the canal originally relies on Shandong's springs and does not depend on Yellow water; one need only imitate the Jingtai-era system of sluices at the north and south mouths of the Two Rapids—below Zhenkou, above Dafuqiao, at Lüliang's lower rapid, and at Pizhou's Shafang, build stone sluices each to regulate Wen and Si, aided by Xiaofuqiao and the Yi River mouth; further west of Zhenkou build a dam to cut the Yellow, open Tangjiakou to pour into Longgou, join Xiaofuqiao to enter the canal, and stop the harm of backflow silt at Zhenkou—a truly perfect plan.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the canal originally relies on Shandong's springs and does not depend on Yellow water; one need only imitate the Jingtai-era system of sluices at the north and south mouths of the Two Rapids—below Zhenkou, above Dafuqiao, at Lüliang's lower rapid, and at Pizhou's Shafang, build stone sluices each to regulate Wen and Si, aided by Xiaofuqiao and the Yi River mouth; further west of Zhenkou build a dam to cut the Yellow, open Tangjiakou to pour into Longgou, join Xiaofuqiao to enter the canal, and stop the harm of backflow silt at Zhenkou—a truly perfect plan.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春，從楊光訓等議，撤鈇，命一魁兼管漕運。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year, following Yang Guangxun and others, Tie was removed and Yikui was ordered also to oversee grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year, following Yang Guangxun and others, Tie was removed and Yikui was ordered also to oversee grain transport.

sentences.zh: 六月，召一魁掌部事，命劉東星為工部侍郎，總理河漕。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yikui was summoned to head the ministry; Liu Dongxing was appointed Works Vice Minister to oversee rivers and grain transport overall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yikui was summoned to head the ministry; Liu Dongxing was appointed Works Vice Minister to oversee rivers and grain transport overall.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春，東星上言：「河自商、虞而下，由丁家道口抵韓家道口、趙家圈、石將軍廟、兩河口，出小浮橋下二洪，乃賈魯故道也。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-seventh year Dongxing memorialized: "Below Shang and Yu the river from Dingjiadao reaches Hanjiadao, Zhaojiaquan, Shijiangjun Temple, and Lianghekou, exits at Xiaofuqiao below the Two Rapids—that is Jia Lu's old channel.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-seventh year Dongxing memorialized: "Below Shang and Yu the river from Dingjiadao reaches Hanjiadao, Zhaojiaquan, Shijiangjun Temple, and Lianghekou, exits at Xiaofuqiao below the Two Rapids—that is Jia Lu's old channel.

sentences.zh: 自元及我朝行之甚利。

translations.literal: From Yuan times and our dynasty it was run with great benefit.
translations.idiomatic: From Yuan times and our dynasty it was run with great benefit.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十七年北徙濁河，而此河遂淤。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing it shifted north to the Zhuo River and this channel silted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing it shifted north to the Zhuo River and this channel silted.

sentences.zh: 潘季馴議復開之，以工費浩繁而止。

translations.literal: Pan Jixun proposed reopening it but stopped because of vast expense.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Jixun proposed reopening it but stopped because of vast expense.

sentences.zh: 今河東決黃堌，由韓家道口至趙家圈百餘里，沖刷成河，即季馴議復之故道也。

translations.literal: Now the river has breached east at Huanggu; from Hanjiadao to Zhaojiaquan for more than a hundred li scouring has formed a channel—that is exactly the old channel Jixun proposed restoring.
translations.idiomatic: Now the river has breached east at Huanggu; from Hanjiadao to Zhaojiaquan for more than a hundred li scouring has formed a channel—that is exactly the old channel Jixun proposed restoring.

sentences.zh: 由趙家圈至兩河口，直接三仙臺新渠，長僅四十里，募夫五萬浚之，逾月當竣，而大挑運河，小挑濁河，俱可節省。

translations.literal: From Zhaojiaquan to Lianghekou it connects directly to the Sanxiantai new canal, only forty li long; recruit fifty thousand laborers to dredge it and in a month it should be finished, while great dredging of the canal and small dredging of the Zhuo River can both be saved.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhaojiaquan to Lianghekou it connects directly to the Sanxiantai new canal, only forty li long; recruit fifty thousand laborers to dredge it and in a month it should be finished, while great dredging of the canal and small dredging of the Zhuo River can both be saved.

sentences.zh: 惟李吉口故道嘗挑復淤，去冬已挑數里，前功難棄，然至鎮口三百里而遙，不若趙家圈至兩河口四十里而近。

translations.literal: Only the Lijikou old channel, once dredged, silted again; last winter several li were dredged and earlier work is hard to abandon—yet it is three hundred li to Zhenkou, not as close as the forty li from Zhaojiaquan to Lianghekou.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Lijikou old channel, once dredged, silted again; last winter several li were dredged and earlier work is hard to abandon—yet it is three hundred li to Zhenkou, not as close as the forty li from Zhaojiaquan to Lianghekou.

sentences.zh: 況大浮橋已建閘蓄汶、泗之水，則鎮口濟運亦無藉黃流。

translations.literal: Moreover Dafuqiao already has sluices storing Wen and Si water, so aiding transport at Zhenkou also need not rely on Yellow flow.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Dafuqiao already has sluices storing Wen and Si water, so aiding transport at Zhenkou also need not rely on Yellow flow.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 十月，功成，加東星工部尚書，一魁及餘官賞賚有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the work was completed; Dongxing was promoted to Works Minister and Yikui and the other officials received rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the work was completed; Dongxing was promoted to Works Minister and Yikui and the other officials received rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 初，給事中楊廷蘭因黃堌之決，請開泇河，給事中楊應文亦主其說。

translations.literal: Earlier, Supervising Secretary Yang Tinglan, because of the Huanggu breach, had asked to open the Si River; Supervising Secretary Yang Yingwen also supported the view.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Supervising Secretary Yang Tinglan, because of the Huanggu breach, had asked to open the Si River; Supervising Secretary Yang Yingwen also supported the view.

sentences.zh: 既而直隸巡按御史佴祺復言之。

translations.literal: Later Zhili investigating censor Ni Qi spoke of it again.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhili investigating censor Ni Qi spoke of it again.

sentences.zh: 東星既開趙家圈，復採眾說，鑿泇河，以地多沙石，工未就而東星病。

translations.literal: After Dongxing opened Zhaojiaquan he again took various views and cut the Si River; because the ground had much sand and stone the work was not finished before Dongxing fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: After Dongxing opened Zhaojiaquan he again took various views and cut the Si River; because the ground had much sand and stone the work was not finished before Dongxing fell ill.

sentences.zh: 河既南徙，李吉口淤氵殿日高，北流遂絕，而趙家圈亦日就淤塞，徐、邳間三百里，河水尺餘，糧艘阻塞。

translations.literal: The river having shifted south, Lijikou silt rose day by day and northern flow ceased; Zhaojiaquan also daily silted, and for three hundred li between Xu and Pi river water was barely a chi or more and grain ships were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The river having shifted south, Lijikou silt rose day by day and northern flow ceased; Zhaojiaquan also daily silted, and for three hundred li between Xu and Pi river water was barely a chi or more and grain ships were blocked.

sentences.zh: 二十九年秋，工科給事中張問達疏論之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-ninth year Engineering Supervising Secretary Zhang Wenda memorialized on it.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-ninth year Engineering Supervising Secretary Zhang Wenda memorialized on it.

sentences.zh: 會開、歸大水，河漲商丘，決蕭家口，全河盡南注。

translations.literal: Just then Kai and Gui suffered great floods; the river rose at Shangqiu and breached at Xiaojiakou; the whole river poured south.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Kai and Gui suffered great floods; the river rose at Shangqiu and breached at Xiaojiakou; the whole river poured south.

sentences.zh: 河身變為平沙，商賈舟膠沙上。

translations.literal: The river bed became flat sand and merchant boats stuck on the sand.
translations.idiomatic: The river bed became flat sand and merchant boats stuck on the sand.

sentences.zh: 南岸蒙牆寺忽徙置北岸，商、虞多被淹沒，河勢盡趨東南，而黃堌斷流。

translations.literal: Mengqiang Temple on the south bank suddenly shifted to the north bank; Shang and Yu were largely submerged, the river's tendency all rushed southeast, and Huanggu ceased to flow.
translations.idiomatic: Mengqiang Temple on the south bank suddenly shifted to the north bank; Shang and Yu were largely submerged, the river's tendency all rushed southeast, and Huanggu ceased to flow.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫曾如春以聞，曰：「此河徙，非決也。

translations.literal: Henan governor Zeng Ruchun memorialized, saying: "This is river migration, not a breach.
translations.idiomatic: Henan governor Zeng Ruchun memorialized, saying: "This is river migration, not a breach.

sentences.zh: 」問達復言：「蕭家口在黃堌上流，未有商舟不能行於蕭家口而能行於黃堌以東者，運艘大可慮。

translations.literal: " Wenda again said: "Xiaojiakou is upstream of Huanggu; never yet could merchant boats not pass Xiaojiakou yet pass east of Huanggu—the transport fleet is greatly to be worried over.
translations.idiomatic: " Wenda again said: "Xiaojiakou is upstream of Huanggu; never yet could merchant boats not pass Xiaojiakou yet pass east of Huanggu—the transport fleet is greatly to be worried over.

sentences.zh: 」帝從其言，方命東星勘議，而東星卒矣。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his words and was just ordering Dongxing to investigate and debate when Dongxing died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed his words and was just ordering Dongxing to investigate and debate when Dongxing died.

sentences.zh: 問達復言：「運道之壞，一因黃堌口之決，不早杜塞；

translations.literal: Wenda again said: "The transport route's ruin—first because the Huanggu breach was not sealed early;
translations.idiomatic: Wenda again said: "The transport route's ruin—first because the Huanggu breach was not sealed early;

sentences.zh: 更因並力泇河，以致趙家圈淤塞斷流，河身日高，河水日淺，而蕭家口遂決，全河奔潰入淮，勢及陵寢。

translations.literal: second because effort was combined on the Si River, causing Zhaojiaquan to silt and cut flow, the river bed daily higher and water daily shallower, until Xiaojiakou breached and the whole river rushed into the Huai, the force reaching the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: second because effort was combined on the Si River, causing Zhaojiaquan to silt and cut flow, the river bed daily higher and water daily shallower, until Xiaojiakou breached and the whole river rushed into the Huai, the force reaching the tombs.

sentences.zh: 東星已逝，宜急補河臣，早定長策。

translations.literal: Dongxing has passed; river officials should urgently be filled and a long-term plan fixed early.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxing has passed; river officials should urgently be filled and a long-term plan fixed early.

sentences.zh: 」大學士沈一貫、給事中桂有根皆趣簡河臣。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Shen Yiguan and Supervising Secretary Gui Yougen both urged selecting river officials.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Shen Yiguan and Supervising Secretary Gui Yougen both urged selecting river officials.

sentences.zh: 御史高舉獻三策。

translations.literal: Censor Gao Ju submitted three strategies.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Gao Ju submitted three strategies.

sentences.zh: 請浚黃堌口以下舊河，引黃水注之東，遂塞黃堌口，而遏其南，俟舊河沖刷深，則並塞新決之口。

translations.literal: He asked to dredge the old river below Huangguhekou, lead Yellow water east into it, then seal Huangguhekou and check its south; wait until the old river scours deep, then also seal the newly breached mouth.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to dredge the old river below Huangguhekou, lead Yellow water east into it, then seal Huangguhekou and check its south; wait until the old river scours deep, then also seal the newly breached mouth.

sentences.zh: 其二則請開泇河及膠萊河，而言河漕不宜並於一人，當選擇分任其事。

translations.literal: The second asked to open the Si River and Jiao-Lai River, saying river and canal should not be under one man and that choice should divide the duties.
translations.idiomatic: The second asked to open the Si River and Jiao-Lai River, saying river and canal should not be under one man and that choice should divide the duties.

sentences.zh: 江北巡按御史吳崇禮則請自蒙牆寺西北黃河灣曲之所，開浚直河，引水東流。

translations.literal: Jiangbei investigating censor Wu Chongli asked to open a straight channel from the bend northwest of Mengqiang Temple, leading water east.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangbei investigating censor Wu Chongli asked to open a straight channel from the bend northwest of Mengqiang Temple, leading water east.

sentences.zh: 且浚李吉口至堅城集淤道三十餘里，而盡塞黃堌以南決口，使河流盡歸正漕。

translations.literal: He also dredged the silted channel from Lijikou to Jianchengji for more than thirty li, and fully sealed breaches south of Huanggu so the river would all return to the proper canal.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged the silted channel from Lijikou to Jianchengji for more than thirty li, and fully sealed breaches south of Huanggu so the river would all return to the proper canal.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書一魁酌舉崇禮之議，以開直河、塞黃堌口、浚淤道為正策，而以泇河為旁策，膠萊為備策。

translations.literal: Works Minister Yikui weighed Chongli's proposal: opening the straight channel, sealing Huangguhekou, and dredging the silted channel as the main strategy, the Si River as a secondary strategy, and Jiao-Lai as a reserve strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Works Minister Yikui weighed Chongli's proposal: opening the straight channel, sealing Huangguhekou, and dredging the silted channel as the main strategy, the Si River as a secondary strategy, and Jiao-Lai as a reserve strategy.

sentences.zh: 帝命急挑舊河，塞決口，且兼挑泇河以備用。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered urgent dredging of the old river and sealing of breach mouths, and simultaneous dredging of the Si River for reserve use.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered urgent dredging of the old river and sealing of breach mouths, and simultaneous dredging of the Si River for reserve use.

sentences.zh: 下山東撫按勘視膠萊河。

translations.literal: Shandong governors and censors were sent to inspect the Jiao-Lai River.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong governors and censors were sent to inspect the Jiao-Lai River.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，一魁覆河撫如春疏言：「黃河勢趨邳、宿，請築汴堤自歸德至靈、虹，以障南徙。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year Yikui replied to river governor Ruchun's memorial: "The Yellow River's tendency is toward Pi and Su; please build Bian dikes from Guide to Ling and Hong to block southward shift.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirtieth year Yikui replied to river governor Ruchun's memorial: "The Yellow River's tendency is toward Pi and Su; please build Bian dikes from Guide to Ling and Hong to block southward shift.

sentences.zh: 且疏小河口，使黃流盡歸之，則彌漫自消，祖陵可無患。

translations.literal: Also dredge the Xiao River mouth so Yellow flow all returns there; then widespread flooding will naturally subside and the ancestral tombs need not be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Also dredge the Xiao River mouth so Yellow flow all returns there; then widespread flooding will naturally subside and the ancestral tombs need not be harmed.

sentences.zh: 」帝喜納之。

translations.literal: " The emperor gladly accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor gladly accepted it.

sentences.zh: 已而言者再疏攻一魁。

translations.literal: Soon memorialists again repeatedly attacked Yikui.
translations.idiomatic: Soon memorialists again repeatedly attacked Yikui.

sentences.zh: 帝以一魁不塞黃堌口，致沖祖陵，斥為民。

translations.literal: The emperor, holding that Yikui's failure to seal Huangguhekou had struck the ancestral tombs, dismissed him to common status.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, holding that Yikui's failure to seal Huangguhekou had struck the ancestral tombs, dismissed him to common status.

sentences.zh: 復用崇禮議，分設河漕二臣，命如春為工部侍郎，總理河道。

translations.literal: Chongli's plan was again adopted; river and canal officials were split into two posts, and Ruchun was appointed Works Vice Minister to oversee the river course overall.
translations.idiomatic: Chongli's plan was again adopted; river and canal officials were split into two posts, and Ruchun was appointed Works Vice Minister to oversee the river course overall.

sentences.zh: 如春議開虞城王家口，挽全河東歸，須費六十萬。

translations.literal: Ruchun proposed opening Wangjiakou at Yucheng to turn the whole river east—a cost of six hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Ruchun proposed opening Wangjiakou at Yucheng to turn the whole river east—a cost of six hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，山東巡撫黃克纘言：「王家口為蒙牆上源，上流既達，則下流不可旁泄，宜遂塞蒙牆口。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-first year Shandong governor Huang Kezuan said: "Wangjiakou is upstream of Mengqiang; once upstream is open, downstream cannot spill aside—Mengqiang mouth should be sealed at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-first year Shandong governor Huang Kezuan said: "Wangjiakou is upstream of Mengqiang; once upstream is open, downstream cannot spill aside—Mengqiang mouth should be sealed at once.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The order was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The order was followed.

sentences.zh: 時蒙牆決口廣八十餘丈，如春所開新河未及其半，塞而注之，慮不任受。

translations.literal: At that time the Mengqiang breach was more than eighty zhang wide; the new river Ruchun opened had not reached half that width—sealing and pouring into it was feared beyond capacity.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Mengqiang breach was more than eighty zhang wide; the new river Ruchun opened had not reached half that width—sealing and pouring into it was feared beyond capacity.

sentences.zh: 有獻策者言：「河流既回，勢若雷霆，藉其勢沖之，淺者可深也。

translations.literal: Someone offering a stratagem said: "Once the river turns back, its force is like thunder; borrow that force to scour it and what is shallow can become deep.
translations.idiomatic: Someone offering a stratagem said: "Once the river turns back, its force is like thunder; borrow that force to scour it and what is shallow can become deep.

sentences.zh: 」如春遂令放水，水皆泥沙，流少緩，旋淤。

translations.literal: Ruchun thereupon ordered water released; the water was all mud and sand, the flow somewhat slowed, and it quickly silted.
translations.idiomatic: Ruchun thereupon ordered water released; the water was all mud and sand, the flow somewhat slowed, and it quickly silted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，水暴漲，沖魚、單、豐、沛間，如春以憂卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer water surged; it burst between Yu, Shan, Feng, and Pei, and Ruchun died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer water surged; it burst between Yu, Shan, Feng, and Pei, and Ruchun died of grief.

sentences.zh: 乃命李化龍為工部侍郎，代其任。

translations.literal: Li Hualong was then appointed Works Vice Minister to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hualong was then appointed Works Vice Minister to replace him.

sentences.zh: 給事中宋一韓言：「黃河故道已復，陵、運無虞。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Song Yihan said: "The Yellow River's old course has been restored; tombs and transport are without worry.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Song Yihan said: "The Yellow River's old course has been restored; tombs and transport are without worry.

sentences.zh: 決口懼難塞，宜深浚堅城以上淺阻，而增築徐、邳兩岸，使下流有所容，則舊河可塞。
