translations.literal: Breaches are feared hard to seal; deeply dredge the shallows and obstructions above Jiancheng, and raise dikes on both banks at Xu and Pi so downstream has room to hold—then the old river can be sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Breaches are feared hard to seal; deeply dredge the shallows and obstructions above Jiancheng, and raise dikes on both banks at Xu and Pi so downstream has room to hold—then the old river can be sealed.

sentences.zh: 」給事中孟成己言：「塞舊河急，而浚新河尤急。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Meng Chengyi said: "Sealing the old river is urgent, but dredging the new river is even more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Meng Chengyi said: "Sealing the old river is urgent, but dredging the new river is even more urgent.

sentences.zh: 」化龍甫至，河大決單縣蘇家莊及曹縣縷堤，又決沛縣四鋪口太行堤，灌昭陽湖，入夏鎮，橫沖運道。

translations.literal: " Hualong had barely arrived when the river breached greatly at Suzhuang in Shan County and at the thread dike in Cao County, and again at Taixing Embankment at Sipu in Pei County, flooding Zhaoyang Lake, entering Xiamu, and cutting across the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: " Hualong had barely arrived when the river breached greatly at Suzhuang in Shan County and at the thread dike in Cao County, and again at Taixing Embankment at Sipu in Pei County, flooding Zhaoyang Lake, entering Xiamu, and cutting across the transport route.

sentences.zh: 化龍議開泇河，屬之邳州直河，以避河險。

translations.literal: Hualong proposed opening the Si River, assigning it to Pizhou's straight channel to avoid river peril.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong proposed opening the Si River, assigning it to Pizhou's straight channel to avoid river peril.

sentences.zh: 給事中侯慶遠因言：「泇河成，則他工可徐圖，第毋縱河入淮。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Hou Qingyuan therefore said: "Once the Si River is complete, other works can be planned slowly—only do not let the river enter the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Hou Qingyuan therefore said: "Once the Si River is complete, other works can be planned slowly—only do not let the river enter the Huai.

sentences.zh: 淮利則洪澤水減，而陵自安矣。」

translations.literal: If the Huai benefits, Hongze's water will lessen and the tombs will naturally be secure."
translations.idiomatic: If the Huai benefits, Hongze's water will lessen and the tombs will naturally be secure."

sentences.zh: 三十二年正月，部覆化龍疏，大略言：「河自歸德而下，合運入海，其路有三：由蘭陽道考城至李吉口，過堅城集，入六座樓，出茶城而向徐、邳，是名濁河，為中路；

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-second year the ministry replied to Hualong's memorial, in general saying: "Below Guide the river joins the canal to the sea; its routes are three: from Lanyang via Kaocheng to Lijikou, past Jianchengji, entering Liuzuo Lou, exiting at Chacheng toward Xu and Pi—called the Zhuo River, the middle route;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-second year the ministry replied to Hualong's memorial, in general saying: "Below Guide the river joins the canal to the sea; its routes are three: from Lanyang via Kaocheng to Lijikou, past Jianchengji, entering Liuzuo Lou, exiting at Chacheng toward Xu and Pi—called the Zhuo River, the middle route;

sentences.zh: 由曹、單經豐、沛，出飛雲橋，泛昭陽湖，入龍塘，出秦溝而向徐、邳，是名銀河，為北路；

translations.literal: from Cao and Shan via Feng and Pei, exiting at Feiyun Bridge, spreading through Zhaoyang Lake, entering Longtang, exiting at Qingou toward Xu and Pi—called the Silver River, the northern route;
translations.idiomatic: from Cao and Shan via Feng and Pei, exiting at Feiyun Bridge, spreading through Zhaoyang Lake, entering Longtang, exiting at Qingou toward Xu and Pi—called the Silver River, the northern route;

sentences.zh: 由潘家口過司家道口，至何家堤，經符離，道睢寧，入宿遷，出小河口入運，是名符離河，為南路。

translations.literal: from Panjiakou past Sijiadao to Hejiati, via Fuli, through Suining, entering Suqian, exiting at the Xiao River mouth into the canal—called the Fuli River, the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: from Panjiakou past Sijiadao to Hejiati, via Fuli, through Suining, entering Suqian, exiting at the Xiao River mouth into the canal—called the Fuli River, the southern route.

sentences.zh: 南路近陵，北路近運，惟中路既遠於陵，且可濟運，前河臣興役未竣，而河形尚在。

translations.literal: The southern route is near the tombs, the northern near transport; only the middle route is far from the tombs and can aid transport—the former river official's project was not finished, yet the river form remains.
translations.idiomatic: The southern route is near the tombs, the northern near transport; only the middle route is far from the tombs and can aid transport—the former river official's project was not finished, yet the river form remains.

sentences.zh: 」因奏開泇有六善。

translations.literal: " They therefore memorialized six benefits of opening the Si.
translations.idiomatic: " They therefore memorialized six benefits of opening the Si.

sentences.zh: 帝從其議。

translations.literal: The emperor followed the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed the proposal.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書姚繼可言：「黃河沖徙，河臣議於堅城集以上開渠引河，使下流疏通，復分六座樓、苑家樓二路殺其水勢，既可移豐、沛之患，又不至沼碭山之城。

translations.literal: Works Minister Yao Jike said: "Yellow River shifts and migrations—the river officials propose above Jianchengji to open a canal to lead the river so downstream is cleared, and further divide Liuzuo Lou and Yuanjialou in two routes to kill water force—this can move Feng and Pei's calamity and not swamp Dangshan's walls.
translations.idiomatic: Works Minister Yao Jike said: "Yellow River shifts and migrations—the river officials propose above Jianchengji to open a canal to lead the river so downstream is cleared, and further divide Liuzuo Lou and Yuanjialou in two routes to kill water force—this can move Feng and Pei's calamity and not swamp Dangshan's walls.

sentences.zh: 開泇分黃，兩工並舉，乞速發帑以濟。

translations.literal: Opening the Si to split the Yellow—both works together—we beg rapid disbursement from the treasury to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: Opening the Si to split the Yellow—both works together—we beg rapid disbursement from the treasury to aid them.

sentences.zh: 」允之。

translations.literal: " It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " It was granted.

sentences.zh: 八月，化龍奏分水河成。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Hualong reported the division canal complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Hualong reported the division canal complete.

sentences.zh: 事具《泇河志》中。

translations.literal: The matter is recorded in the Si River gazetteer.
translations.idiomatic: The matter is recorded in the Si River gazetteer.

sentences.zh: 加化龍太子少保兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Hualong was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 會化龍丁艱候代，命曹時聘為工部侍郎，總理河道。

translations.literal: Just as Hualong entered mourning and awaited replacement, Cao Shipin was appointed Works Vice Minister to oversee the river course overall.
translations.idiomatic: Just as Hualong entered mourning and awaited replacement, Cao Shipin was appointed Works Vice Minister to oversee the river course overall.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河決豐縣，由昭陽湖穿李家港口，出鎮口，上灌南陽，而單縣決口復潰，魚臺、濟甯間平地成湖。

translations.literal: That autumn the river breached at Feng County, passing through Zhaoyang Lake via Lijia Harbor mouth to exit at Zhenkou, flooding upward into Nanyang; the Shan County breach also collapsed again, and between Yutai and Jining flat land became lakes.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river breached at Feng County, passing through Zhaoyang Lake via Lijia Harbor mouth to exit at Zhenkou, flooding upward into Nanyang; the Shan County breach also collapsed again, and between Yutai and Jining flat land became lakes.

sentences.zh: 三十三年春，化龍言：「豐之失，由巡守不嚴，單之失，由下埽不早，而皆由蘇家莊之決。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-third year Hualong said: "Feng's loss was from lax patrol, Shan's from late lower revetments—and both from the Suzhuang breach.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-third year Hualong said: "Feng's loss was from lax patrol, Shan's from late lower revetments—and both from the Suzhuang breach.

sentences.zh: 南直、山東相推諉，請各罰防河守臣。

translations.literal: Nanzhili and Shandong pushed blame on each other; he asked that each punish river-defense officials.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhili and Shandong pushed blame on each other; he asked that each punish river-defense officials.

sentences.zh: 至年來緩堤防而急挑浚，堤壞水溢，不咎守堤之不力，惟委浚河之不深。

translations.literal: In recent years dikes were slackened while dredging was rushed; dikes broke and water overflowed—they did not blame inadequate dike defense but only blamed insufficient dredging depth.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years dikes were slackened while dredging was rushed; dikes broke and water overflowed—they did not blame inadequate dike defense but only blamed insufficient dredging depth.

sentences.zh: 夫河北岸自曹縣以下無入張秋之路，南岸自虞城以下無入淮之路，惟由徐、邳達鎮口為運道。

translations.literal: North of the river's north bank below Cao County there is no route to Zhangqiu; south of the south bank below Yucheng there is no route to the Huai—only via Xu and Pi reaching Zhenkou is the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: North of the river's north bank below Cao County there is no route to Zhangqiu; south of the south bank below Yucheng there is no route to the Huai—only via Xu and Pi reaching Zhenkou is the transport route.

sentences.zh: 故河北決曹、鄆、豐、沛間，則由昭陽湖出李家口，而運道溢；

translations.literal: Thus if the north bank breaches between Cao, Yun, Feng, and Pei, it exits at Zhaoyang Lake via Lijiakou and the transport route overflows;
translations.idiomatic: Thus if the north bank breaches between Cao, Yun, Feng, and Pei, it exits at Zhaoyang Lake via Lijiakou and the transport route overflows;

sentences.zh: 南決虞、夏、徐、邳間，則由小河口及白洋河，而運道涸。

translations.literal: if the south breaches between Yu, Xia, Xu, and Pi, it goes via the Xiao River mouth and Baiyang River and the transport route dries.
translations.idiomatic: if the south breaches between Yu, Xia, Xu, and Pi, it goes via the Xiao River mouth and Baiyang River and the transport route dries.

sentences.zh: 今泇河既成，起直河至夏鎮，與黃河隔絕，山東、直隸間，河不能制運道之命。

translations.literal: Now the Si River is complete from the straight channel to Xiamu, isolated from the Yellow River; between Shandong and Zhili the river cannot control the transport route's fate.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Si River is complete from the straight channel to Xiamu, isolated from the Yellow River; between Shandong and Zhili the river cannot control the transport route's fate.

sentences.zh: 獨硃旺口以上，決單則單沼，決曹則曹魚，及豐、沛、徐、邳、魚、碭皆命懸一線堤防，何可緩也？

translations.literal: Only above Zhuwangkou—breach Shan and Shan floods, breach Cao and Cao and Yutai flood, and Feng, Pei, Xu, Pi, Yutai, and Dang all hang on a single thread of dike defense—how can it be slackened?
translations.idiomatic: Only above Zhuwangkou—breach Shan and Shan floods, breach Cao and Cao and Yutai flood, and Feng, Pei, Xu, Pi, Yutai, and Dang all hang on a single thread of dike defense—how can it be slackened?

sentences.zh: 至中州荊隆口、銅瓦廂皆入張秋之路，孫家渡、野雞岡、蒙牆寺皆入淮之路，一不守，則北壞運，南犯陵，其害甚大。

translations.literal: At Jinglongkou and Tongwaxiang in central Henan are routes to Zhangqiu; Sunjiadu, Yejigang, and Mengqiang Temple are routes to the Huai—if one is not defended, the north ruins transport and the south violates the tombs; the harm is very great.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinglongkou and Tongwaxiang in central Henan are routes to Zhangqiu; Sunjiadu, Yejigang, and Mengqiang Temple are routes to the Huai—if one is not defended, the north ruins transport and the south violates the tombs; the harm is very great.

sentences.zh: 請西自開封，東至徐、邳，無不守之地，上自司道，下至府縣，無不守之人，庶幾可息河患。

translations.literal: From Kaifeng in the west to Xu and Pi in the east there is no place not to defend; from circuit intendant above to prefecture and county below there is no one not to defend—perhaps river calamity can be stilled.
translations.idiomatic: From Kaifeng in the west to Xu and Pi in the east there is no place not to defend; from circuit intendant above to prefecture and county below there is no one not to defend—perhaps river calamity can be stilled.

sentences.zh: 」乃敕時聘申飭焉。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Shipin to enforce this strictly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered Shipin to enforce this strictly.

sentences.zh: 其秋，時聘言：「自蘇莊一決，全河北注者三年。

translations.literal: That autumn Shipin said: "Since the Suzhuang breach the whole river poured south for three years.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Shipin said: "Since the Suzhuang breach the whole river poured south for three years.

sentences.zh: 初泛豐、沛，繼沼單、魚，陳燦之塞不成，南陽之堤盡壞。

translations.literal: First it spread through Feng and Pei, then flooded Shan and Yutai; Chen Can's sealing did not succeed and Nanyang's dikes were all ruined.
translations.idiomatic: First it spread through Feng and Pei, then flooded Shan and Yutai; Chen Can's sealing did not succeed and Nanyang's dikes were all ruined.

sentences.zh: 今且上灌全濟，旁侵運道矣。

translations.literal: Now it floods all of Ji upward and encroaches on the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: Now it floods all of Ji upward and encroaches on the transport route.

sentences.zh: 臣親詣曹、單，上視王家口新築之壩，下視硃旺口北潰之流，知河之大可憂者三，而機之不可失者二。

translations.literal: I personally went to Cao and Shan; looking upstream at the new dam at Wangjiakou and downstream at the north-collapsed flow at Zhuwangkou, I know three great worries of the river—and two opportunities that must not be lost.
translations.idiomatic: I personally went to Cao and Shan; looking upstream at the new dam at Wangjiakou and downstream at the north-collapsed flow at Zhuwangkou, I know three great worries of the river—and two opportunities that must not be lost.

sentences.zh: 河決行堤，泛溢平地，昭陽日墊，下流日淤，水出李家口者日漸微緩，勢不得不退而上溢。

translations.literal: The river breaches along the traveling dike, spreads over flat land, Zhaoyang daily silts and downstream daily silts; water exiting Lijiakou grows daily somewhat slower and weaker—the tendency must retreat and overflow upward.
translations.idiomatic: The river breaches along the traveling dike, spreads over flat land, Zhaoyang daily silts and downstream daily silts; water exiting Lijiakou grows daily somewhat slower and weaker—the tendency must retreat and overflow upward.

sentences.zh: 溢於南，則孫家渡、野雞岡皆入淮故道，毋謂蒙牆已塞，而無憂於陵。

translations.literal: Overflowing south, Sunjiadu and Yejigang are all old routes into the Huai—do not say Mengqiang is already sealed and there is no worry for the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Overflowing south, Sunjiadu and Yejigang are all old routes into the Huai—do not say Mengqiang is already sealed and there is no worry for the tombs.

sentences.zh: 溢於北，則芝麻莊、荊隆口皆入張秋故道，毋謂泇役已成，而無憂於運。

translations.literal: Overflowing north, Zhimazhuang and Jinglongkou are all old routes to Zhangqiu—do not say the Si project is complete and there is no worry for transport.
translations.idiomatic: Overflowing north, Zhimazhuang and Jinglongkou are all old routes to Zhangqiu—do not say the Si project is complete and there is no worry for transport.

sentences.zh: 且南之夏、商，北之曹、濮，其地益插，其禍益烈，其挽回益不易，毋謂災止魚、濟，而無憂於民。

translations.literal: South at Xia and Shang, north at Cao and Pu—the land grows more pinched and the disaster fiercer and reversal harder; do not say the calamity stops at Yutai and Ji and there is no worry for the people.
translations.idiomatic: South at Xia and Shang, north at Cao and Pu—the land grows more pinched and the disaster fiercer and reversal harder; do not say the calamity stops at Yutai and Ji and there is no worry for the people.

sentences.zh: 顧自王家口以達硃旺，新導之河在焉。

translations.literal: Yet from Wangjiakou reaching Zhuwang, the newly guided river lies there.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from Wangjiakou reaching Zhuwang, the newly guided river lies there.

sentences.zh: 疏其下流以出小浮橋，則三百里長河暢流，機可乘者一。

translations.literal: Clear its downstream to exit at Xiaofuqiao and the three-hundred-li long river will flow freely—one opportunity that can be seized.
translations.idiomatic: Clear its downstream to exit at Xiaofuqiao and the three-hundred-li long river will flow freely—one opportunity that can be seized.

sentences.zh: 自徐而下，清黃並行，沙隨水刷，此數十年所未有，因而導水歸徐，容受有地，機可乘者二。

translations.literal: Below Xu, clear and Yellow run parallel and sand scours with water—something not seen in decades; thus guide water back to Xu and there is room to receive it— a second opportunity that can be seized.
translations.idiomatic: Below Xu, clear and Yellow run parallel and sand scours with water—something not seen in decades; thus guide water back to Xu and there is room to receive it—a second opportunity that can be seized.

sentences.zh: 臣與諸臣熟計，河之中路有南北二支：北出濁河，嘗再疏再壅；

translations.literal: I and the officials deliberated: the river's middle route has north and south branches—the north exits at the Zhuo River, dredged twice and blocked twice;
translations.idiomatic: I and the officials deliberated: the river's middle route has north and south branches—the north exits at the Zhuo River, dredged twice and blocked twice;

sentences.zh: 惟南出小浮橋，地形卑下，其勢甚順，度長三萬丈有奇，估銀八十萬兩。

translations.literal: only the south exiting at Xiaofuqiao has low terrain and very favorable tendency—length estimated at more than thirty thousand zhang, cost estimated at eight hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: only the south exiting at Xiaofuqiao has low terrain and very favorable tendency—length estimated at more than thirty thousand zhang, cost estimated at eight hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 公諸虛耗，乞多方處給。

translations.literal: Public funds are wasted; we beg funds from many sources.
translations.idiomatic: Public funds are wasted; we beg funds from many sources.

sentences.zh: 」疏上留中。

translations.literal: " The memorial was held at court.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was held at court.

sentences.zh: 時聘乃大挑硃旺口。

translations.literal: Shipin then greatly dredged Zhuwangkou.
translations.idiomatic: Shipin then greatly dredged Zhuwangkou.

sentences.zh: 十一月興工，用夫五十萬。

translations.literal: Work began in the eleventh month with five hundred thousand laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Work began in the eleventh month with five hundred thousand laborers.

sentences.zh: 三十四年四月，工成，自硃旺達小浮橋延袤百七十里，渠廣堤厚，河歸故道。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year the work was complete—from Zhuwang to Xiaofuqiao extending one hundred seventy li, channel broad and dikes thick, the river returned to its old course.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year the work was complete—from Zhuwang to Xiaofuqiao extending one hundred seventy li, channel broad and dikes thick, the river returned to its old course.

sentences.zh: 六月，河決蕭縣郭暖樓人字口，北支至茶城、鎮口。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the river breached at the ren-shaped mouth at Guonuanlou in Xiaoxian; the northern branch reached Chacheng and Zhenkou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the river breached at the ren-shaped mouth at Guonuanlou in Xiaoxian; the northern branch reached Chacheng and Zhenkou.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，決單縣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year it breached at Shan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year it breached at Shan County.

sentences.zh: 三十九年六月，決徐州狼矢溝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-ninth year it breached at Langshigou in Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-ninth year it breached at Langshigou in Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 四十年九月，決徐州三山，沖縷堤二百八十丈，遙堤百七十餘丈，梨林鋪以下二十里正河悉為平陸，邳、睢河水耗竭。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fortieth year it breached at Sanshan in Xuzhou, breaching thread dikes for two hundred eighty zhang and remote dikes for more than one hundred seventy zhang; the main channel below Lilinp for twenty li all became flat land, and Pi and Sui river water was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fortieth year it breached at Sanshan in Xuzhou, breaching thread dikes for two hundred eighty zhang and remote dikes for more than one hundred seventy zhang; the main channel below Lilinp for twenty li all became flat land, and Pi and Sui river water was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 總河都御史劉士忠開韓家壩外小渠引水，由是壩以東始通舟楫。

translations.literal: Grand Canal Director Liu Shizhong opened a small channel outside Hanjiaba to lead water; from that dam eastward boats could at last pass.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal Director Liu Shizhong opened a small channel outside Hanjiaba to lead water; from that dam eastward boats could at last pass.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，決靈璧陳鋪。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year it breached at Chenpu in Lingbi.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year it breached at Chenpu in Lingbi.

sentences.zh: 四十四年五月，復決狼矢溝，由蛤鰻、周柳諸湖入泇河，出直口，復與黃會。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the forty-fourth year it breached again at Langshigou, passing through Haman, Zhouliu, and other lakes into the Si River, exiting at the straight mouth, and again joining the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the forty-fourth year it breached again at Langshigou, passing through Haman, Zhouliu, and other lakes into the Si River, exiting at the straight mouth, and again joining the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 六月，決開封陶家店、張家灣，由會城大堤下陳留，入亳州渦河。

translations.literal: In the sixth month it breached at Taojiadian and Zhangjiawan in Kaifeng, passing under the Huicheng great dike to Chenliu and entering the Wo River at Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month it breached at Taojiadian and Zhangjiawan in Kaifeng, passing under the Huicheng great dike to Chenliu and entering the Wo River at Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 四十七年九月，決陽武脾沙堽，由封丘、曹、單至考城，復入舊河。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the forty-seventh year it breached at Pishagang in Yangwu, via Fengqiu, Cao, and Shan to Kaocheng, re-entering the old river.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the forty-seventh year it breached at Pishagang in Yangwu, via Fengqiu, Cao, and Shan to Kaocheng, re-entering the old river.

sentences.zh: 時朝政日馳，河臣奏報多不省。

translations.literal: Court affairs daily slackened; river officials' reports were often not reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Court affairs daily slackened; river officials' reports were often not reviewed.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，劉士忠卒，總河閱三年不補。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year Liu Shizhong died; the grand canal post went unfilled for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year Liu Shizhong died; the grand canal post went unfilled for three years.

sentences.zh: 四十六年閏四月，始命工部侍郎王佐督河道。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the forty-sixth year Works Vice Minister Wang Zuo was at last ordered to supervise the river course.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of the forty-sixth year Works Vice Minister Wang Zuo was at last ordered to supervise the river course.

sentences.zh: 河防日以廢壞，當事者不能有為。

translations.literal: River defenses daily fell into ruin and those in charge could not act effectively.
translations.idiomatic: River defenses daily fell into ruin and those in charge could not act effectively.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，河決靈譬雙溝、黃鋪，由永姬湖出白洋、小河口，仍與黃會，故道湮涸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi the river breached at Shuanggou and Huangpu in Lingbi, exiting via Yongji Lake at Baiyang and the Xiao River mouth, again joining the Yellow; the old channel silted dry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi the river breached at Shuanggou and Huangpu in Lingbi, exiting via Yongji Lake at Baiyang and the Xiao River mouth, again joining the Yellow; the old channel silted dry.

sentences.zh: 總河侍郎陳道亨役夫築塞。

translations.literal: Grand Canal Vice Minister Chen Daohheng mobilized laborers to build and seal.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal Vice Minister Chen Daohheng mobilized laborers to build and seal.

sentences.zh: 時淮安霪雨連旬，黃、淮暴漲數尺，而山陽裏外河及清河決口匯成巨浸，水灌淮城，民蟻城以居，舟行街市。

translations.literal: At that time Huai'an had continuous rain for ten days; Yellow and Huai surged several chi; inner and outer rivers at Shanyang and Qinghe breach mouths pooled into a great flood, water flooding Huai city; people lived on the city like ants and boats traveled the market streets.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Huai'an had continuous rain for ten days; Yellow and Huai surged several chi; inner and outer rivers at Shanyang and Qinghe breach mouths pooled into a great flood, water flooding Huai city; people lived on the city like ants and boats traveled the market streets.

sentences.zh: 久之始塞。

translations.literal: Only after a long time was it sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Only after a long time was it sealed.

sentences.zh: 三年，決徐州青田大龍口，徐、邳、靈、睢河並淤，呂梁城南隅隱，沙高平地丈許，雙溝決口亦滿，上下百五十里悉成平陸。

translations.literal: In the third year it breached at Qingtian Dalongkou in Xuzhou; Xu, Pi, Ling, and Sui rivers all silted; Lüliang's south corner was hidden, sand a chi or more above flat ground; Shuanggou breach mouths were also full and for one hundred fifty li upstream and downstream all became flat land.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year it breached at Qingtian Dalongkou in Xuzhou; Xu, Pi, Ling, and Sui rivers all silted; Lüliang's south corner was hidden, sand a chi or more above flat ground; Shuanggou breach mouths were also full and for one hundred fifty li upstream and downstream all became flat land.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，決徐州魁山堤，東北灌州城，城中水深一丈三尺，一自南門至雲龍山西北大安橋入石狗湖，一由舊支河南流至鄧二莊，曆租溝東南以達小河，出白洋，仍與黃會。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year it breached at Kuishan Embankment in Xuzhou, flooding Guizhou city to the northeast; water in the city was one chi and three cun deep—one route from the south gate to Yunlong Mountain's northwest Da'an Bridge into Shigou Lake, one by the old branch south to Deng'erzhuang, passing Zugou southeast to reach the small river, exiting at Baiyang, again joining the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year it breached at Kuishan Embankment in Xuzhou, flooding Guizhou city to the northeast; water in the city was one chi and three cun deep—one route from the south gate to Yunlong Mountain's northwest Da'an Bridge into Shigou Lake, one by the old branch south to Deng'erzhuang, passing Zugou southeast to reach the small river, exiting at Baiyang, again joining the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 徐民苦淹溺，議集貲遷城。

translations.literal: Xu people suffered drowning; some proposed pooling funds to move the city.
translations.idiomatic: Xu people suffered drowning; some proposed pooling funds to move the city.

sentences.zh: 給事中陸文獻上徐城不可遷六議。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Lu Wenxian submitted six arguments that Xu city could not be moved.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Lu Wenxian submitted six arguments that Xu city could not be moved.

sentences.zh: 而勢不得已，遂遷州治於雲龍，河事置不講矣。

translations.literal: Yet circumstances forced it; the prefectural seat was moved to Yunlong and river affairs were set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Yet circumstances forced it; the prefectural seat was moved to Yunlong and river affairs were set aside.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，河決淮安，逆入駱馬湖，灌邳、宿。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year the river breached at Huai'an, backing into Luoma Lake, flooding Pi and Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year the river breached at Huai'an, backing into Luoma Lake, flooding Pi and Su.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年春，河決曹縣十四鋪口。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Chongzhen the river breached at Shisipu in Cao County.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Chongzhen the river breached at Shisipu in Cao County.

sentences.zh: 四月，決睢寧，至七月中，城盡圮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month it breached at Suining; by mid-seventh month the city walls were entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month it breached at Suining; by mid-seventh month the city walls were entirely destroyed.

sentences.zh: 總河侍郎李若星請遷城避之，而開邳州壩泄水入故道，且塞曹家口匙頭灣，逼水北注，以減睢寧之患。

translations.literal: Grand Canal Vice Minister Li Ruoxing asked to move the city to avoid it, open the Pi dam to discharge water into the old channel, and seal Caojiakou and Chitouwan to force water north and lessen Suining's calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal Vice Minister Li Ruoxing asked to move the city to avoid it, open the Pi dam to discharge water into the old channel, and seal Caojiakou and Chitouwan to force water north and lessen Suining's calamity.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，河決原武湖村鋪，又決封丘荊隆口，敗曹縣塔兒灣大行堤。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year the river breached at Hucunpu in Yuanwu and again at Jinglongkou in Fengqiu, breaking the Taixing Embankment at Ta'erwan in Cao County.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fourth year the river breached at Hucunpu in Yuanwu and again at Jinglongkou in Fengqiu, breaking the Taixing Embankment at Ta'erwan in Cao County.

sentences.zh: 六月黃、淮交漲，海口壅塞，河決建義諸口，下灌興化、鹽城，水深二丈，村落盡漂沒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yellow and Huai rose together; the estuary was blocked; the river breached at Jianyi and other mouths, flooding downward into Xinghua and Yancheng, water two zhang deep, villages all swept away.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yellow and Huai rose together; the estuary was blocked; the river breached at Jianyi and other mouths, flooding downward into Xinghua and Yancheng, water two zhang deep, villages all swept away.

sentences.zh: 逡巡逾年，始議築塞。

translations.literal: After hesitation of more than a year, sealing was at last debated.
translations.idiomatic: After hesitation of more than a year, sealing was at last debated.

sentences.zh: 興工未幾，伏秋水發，黃、淮奔注，興、鹽為壑，而海潮復逆沖，壞範公堤。

translations.literal: Work had barely begun when autumn flood waters came; Yellow and Huai poured in, Xing and Yan became basins, and sea tides again struck back, breaking Fan Gong Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: Work had barely begun when autumn flood waters came; Yellow and Huai poured in, Xing and Yan became basins, and sea tides again struck back, breaking Fan Gong Embankment.

sentences.zh: 軍民及商灶戶死者無算，少壯轉徙，丐江、儀、通、泰間，盜賊千百嘯聚。

translations.literal: Soldiers, civilians, and salt-field households died beyond counting; the young and strong migrated, begging between Jiang, Yi, Tong, and Tai; robbers gathered by the hundreds and thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers, civilians, and salt-field households died beyond counting; the young and strong migrated, begging between Jiang, Yi, Tong, and Tai; robbers gathered by the hundreds and thousands.

sentences.zh: 至六年，鹽城民徐瑞等言其狀。

translations.literal: By the sixth year Yancheng commoner Xu Rui and others spoke of the situation.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth year Yancheng commoner Xu Rui and others spoke of the situation.

sentences.zh: 帝憫之，命議罰河曹官。

translations.literal: The emperor took pity and ordered debate on punishing river officials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took pity and ordered debate on punishing river officials.

sentences.zh: 而是時，總河硃光祚方議開高堰三閘。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Grand Canal Director Zhu Guangzuo was debating opening three sluices at Gaoya Weir.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Grand Canal Director Zhu Guangzuo was debating opening three sluices at Gaoya Weir.

sentences.zh: 淮、揚在朝者合疏言：「建義諸口未塞，民田盡沉水底。

translations.literal: Huai and Yang officials at court jointly memorialized: "Jianyi and other mouths are not sealed and civilian fields are all sunk beneath water.
translations.idiomatic: Huai and Yang officials at court jointly memorialized: "Jianyi and other mouths are not sealed and civilian fields are all sunk beneath water.

sentences.zh: 三閘一開，高、寶諸邑蕩為湖海，而漕糧鹽課皆害矣。

translations.literal: Once the three sluices open, Gaoyou and Baoying counties will be swept into lake and sea, and grain transport and salt levies will all be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the three sluices open, Gaoyou and Baoying counties will be swept into lake and sea, and grain transport and salt levies will all be harmed.

sentences.zh: 高堰建閘始於萬曆二十三年，未幾全塞。

translations.literal: Building sluices at Gaoya Weir began in the twenty-third year of Wanli and before long was fully sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Building sluices at Gaoya Weir began in the twenty-third year of Wanli and before long was fully sealed.

sentences.zh: 今高堰日壞，方當急議修築，可輕言開浚乎？

translations.literal: Now Gaoya Weir daily decays—urgent debate should repair it; can one lightly speak of opening and dredging?
translations.idiomatic: Now Gaoya Weir daily decays—urgent debate should repair it; can one lightly speak of opening and dredging?

sentences.zh: 」帝是其言，事遂寢。

translations.literal: " The emperor agreed and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 又從御史吳振纓請，修宿、寧上下西北舊堤，以捍歸仁。

translations.literal: Following censor Wu Zhenying's request, the old dikes northwest of Su and Ning above and below were repaired to ward off Guiren.
translations.idiomatic: At censor Wu Zhenying's request, the old dikes northwest of Su and Ning upstream and downstream were repaired to ward off Guiren.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，建義決口工成，賜督漕尚書楊一鵬、總河尚書劉榮嗣銀幣。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year work at the Jianyi breach mouth was complete; Grain Transport Director Yang Yipeng and Grand Canal Director Liu Rongsi were granted silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year work at the Jianyi breach mouth was completed; grain transport director Yang Yipeng and grand canal director Liu Rongsi were granted silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 八年九月，榮嗣得罪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year Rongsi fell from favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eighth year Rongsi fell from favor.

sentences.zh: 初，榮嗣以駱馬湖運道潰淤，創挽河之議，起宿遷至徐州，別鑿新河，分黃水注其中，以通漕運。

translations.literal: Earlier Rongsi, because the Luoma Lake transport route breached and silted, devised a plan to haul the canal—from Suqian to Xuzhou cutting a separate new channel and pouring Yellow water into it to open grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Rongsi, because the Luoma Lake transport route had breached and silted, devised a plan to haul the canal—from Suqian to Xuzhou cutting a separate new channel and pouring Yellow water into it to open grain transport.

sentences.zh: 計工二百餘里，金錢五十萬。

translations.literal: The project was more than two hundred li and five hundred thousand in cash.
translations.idiomatic: The project was more than two hundred li and five hundred thousand in cash.

sentences.zh: 而其所鑿邳州上下，悉黃河故道，浚尺許，其下皆沙，挑掘成河，經宿沙落，河坎復平，如此者數四。

translations.literal: What he cut above and below Pizhou was all old Yellow River bed; dredging a chi or so, below was all sand—digging formed a channel, overnight sand fell and the river bank was flat again; this happened four times.
translations.idiomatic: What he cut above and below Pizhou was all old Yellow River bed; dredging a chi or so, below was all sand—digging formed a channel, overnight sand fell and the river bank was flat again; this happened four times.

sentences.zh: 迨引黃水入其中，波流迅急，沙隨水下，率淤淺不可以舟。

translations.literal: When Yellow water was led in, the waves ran swift and sand followed water down, mostly silted shallow and unusable for boats.
translations.idiomatic: When Yellow water was led in, the waves ran swift and sand followed the water down, mostly silted shallow and unusable for boats.

sentences.zh: 及漕舟將至，而駱馬湖之潰決適平，舟人皆不願由新河。

translations.literal: When grain boats were about to arrive, the Luoma Lake breach happened to be level and boatmen all refused the new channel.
translations.idiomatic: When grain boats were about to arrive, the Luoma Lake breach happened to be level and boatmen all refused the new channel.

sentences.zh: 榮嗣自往督之，欲繩以軍法。

translations.literal: Rongsi went personally to supervise and wished to bind them with military law.
translations.idiomatic: Rongsi went personally to supervise and wished to bind them with military law.

sentences.zh: 有入者輒苦淤淺，弁卒多怨。

translations.literal: Those who entered always suffered shallow silt; soldiers and runners mostly resented it.
translations.idiomatic: Those who entered always suffered shallow silt; soldiers and runners mostly resented it.

sentences.zh: 巡漕御史倪於義劾其欺罔誤工，南京給事中曹景參復重劾之，逮問，坐贓，父子皆瘐死。

translations.literal: Canal investigating censor Ni Yuyi impeached him for deception and wasted work; Nanjing supervising secretary Cao Jingcan again impeached heavily; he was arrested and questioned, convicted of corruption, and father and son both died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Canal investigating censor Ni Yuyi impeached him for deception and wasted work; Nanjing supervising secretary Cao Jingcan again impeached heavily; he was arrested and questioned, convicted of corruption, and father and son both died in prison.

sentences.zh: 郎中胡璉分工獨多，亦坐死。

translations.literal: Director Hu Lian's division of work alone was greater; he also died by conviction.
translations.idiomatic: Director Hu Lian's division of work alone was greater; he also died by conviction.

sentences.zh: 其後駱馬湖復潰，舟行新河，無不思榮嗣功者。

translations.literal: Later Luoma Lake breached again; boats on the new channel all missed Rongsi's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Later Luoma Lake breached again; boats on the new channel all missed Rongsi's achievement.

sentences.zh: 當是時，河患日棘，而帝又重法懲下，李若星以修浚不力罷官，硃光祚以建義蘇嘴決口逮繫。

translations.literal: At that time river calamity daily tightened and the emperor again punished subordinates severely; Li Ruoxing was dismissed for ineffective repair and dredging, Zhu Guangzuo was arrested for the Jianyi Sizui breach mouth.
translations.idiomatic: At that time river calamity daily tightened and the emperor again punished subordinates severely; Li Ruoxing was dismissed for ineffective repair and dredging, Zhu Guangzuo was arrested for the Jianyi Sizui breach mouth.

sentences.zh: 六年之中，河臣三易。

translations.literal: In six years river officials changed three times.
translations.idiomatic: In six years river officials changed three times.

sentences.zh: 給事中王家彥嘗切言之。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Wang Jiayan once spoke of it sharply.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Wang Jiayan once spoke of it sharply.

sentences.zh: 光祚亦竟瘐死。

translations.literal: Guangzuo also ultimately died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzuo also ultimately died in prison.

sentences.zh: 而繼榮嗣者周鼎修泇利運頗有功，在事五年，竟坐漕舟阻淺，用故決河防例，遣戍煙瘴。

translations.literal: His successor Zhou Ding repaired the Si for transport benefit with considerable achievement; in five years in office he was finally sentenced to frontier exile by the old precedent for breach of river defense because grain boats were blocked shallow.
translations.idiomatic: His successor Zhou Ding repaired the Si for transport benefit with considerable achievement; in five years in office he was finally sentenced to frontier exile by the old precedent for breach of river defense because grain boats were blocked shallow.

sentences.zh: 給事中沈胤培、刑部侍郎惠世揚、總河侍郎張國維各疏請寬之，乃獲宥免云。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Shen Yinpei, Punishments Vice Minister Hui Shiyang, and Grand Canal Vice Minister Zhang Guowei each memorialized asking leniency; he was pardoned and exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Shen Yinpei, Punishments Vice Minister Hui Shiyang, and Grand Canal Vice Minister Zhang Guowei each memorialized asking leniency; he was pardoned and exempted.

sentences.zh: 十五年，流賊圍開封久，守臣謀引黃河灌之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year bandits besieged Kaifeng long; defending officials planned to lead the Yellow River to flood them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year bandits besieged Kaifeng long; defending officials planned to lead the Yellow River to flood them.

sentences.zh: 賊偵知，預為備。

translations.literal: The bandits learned and prepared in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits learned and prepared in advance.

sentences.zh: 乘水漲，令其黨決河灌城，民盡溺死。

translations.literal: Taking advantage of rising water, their agents breached the river to flood the city and the people all drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Taking advantage of rising water, their agents breached the river to flood the city and the people all drowned.

sentences.zh: 總河侍郎張國維方奉詔赴京，奏其狀。

translations.literal: Grand Canal Vice Minister Zhang Guowei was just ordered to the capital and memorialized the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal Vice Minister Zhang Guowei was just ordered to the capital and memorialized the situation.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫王永吉上言：「黃河決汴城，直走睢陽，東南注鄢陵、鹿邑，必害亳、泗，侵祖陵，而邳、宿運河必涸。

translations.literal: Shandong governor Wang Yongji memorialized: "The Yellow River breached Kaifeng city and ran straight to Suiyang, pouring southeast into Yanling and Luyi—it must harm Bo and Si and invade the ancestral tombs, and the Pi and Su canal must dry.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong governor Wang Yongji memorialized: "The Yellow River breached Kaifeng city and ran straight to Suiyang, pouring southeast into Yanling and Luyi—it must harm Bo and Si and invade the ancestral tombs, and the Pi and Su canal must dry.

sentences.zh: 」帝令總河侍郎黃希憲急往捍禦，希憲以身居濟寧不能攝汴，請特設重臣督理。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Grand Canal Vice Minister Huang Xixian to rush to defend; Xixian, being at Jining and unable to oversee Bian, asked that a specially appointed senior official supervise.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Grand Canal Vice Minister Huang Xixian to rush to defend; Xixian, being at Jining and unable to oversee Bian, asked that a specially appointed senior official supervise.

sentences.zh: 命工部侍郎周堪賡督修汴河。

translations.literal: Works Vice Minister Zhou Kaneng was ordered to supervise repair of the Bian River.
translations.idiomatic: Works Vice Minister Zhou Kaneng was ordered to supervise repair of the Bian River.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月，堪賡上言：「河之決口有二：一為硃家寨，寬二里許，居河下流，水面寬而水勢緩；

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixteenth year Kaneng memorialized: "The breach mouths are two: one at Zhujiazhai, about two li wide, on the river's lower reach—water surface wide and current slow;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixteenth year Kaneng memorialized: "The breach mouths are two: one at Zhujiazhai, about two li wide, on the river's lower reach—water surface wide and current slow;

sentences.zh: 一為馬家口，寬一里餘，居河上流，水勢猛，深不可測。

translations.literal: one at Majiakou, a bit more than one li wide, on the river's upper reach—current fierce, depth beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: one at Majiakou, a bit more than one li wide, on the river's upper reach—current fierce, depth beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 兩口相距三十里，至汴堤之外，合為一流，決一大口，直沖汴城以去，而河之故道則涸為平地。

translations.literal: The two mouths thirty li apart, beyond the Bian embankment, join as one flow, breaching one great mouth and rushing straight at Kaifeng city, while the river's old course dried to flat land.
translations.idiomatic: The two mouths thirty li apart, beyond the Bian embankment, join as one flow, breaching one great mouth and rushing straight at Kaifeng city, while the river's old course dried to flat land.

sentences.zh: 怒濤千頃，工力難施，必廣浚舊渠，遠數十里，分殺水勢，然後畚鍤可措。

translations.literal: Angry billows a thousand qing—labor cannot be applied; the old channel must be broadly dredged far for dozens of li to divide and kill water force—then baskets and spades can be set.
translations.idiomatic: Angry billows a thousand qing—labor cannot be applied; the old channel must be broadly dredged far for dozens of li to divide and kill water force—then baskets and spades can be set.

sentences.zh: 顧築浚並舉，需夫三萬。

translations.literal: Yet building and dredging together require thirty thousand laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Yet building and dredging together require thirty thousand laborers.

sentences.zh: 河北荒旱，兗西兵火，竭力以供，不滿萬人，河南萬死一生之餘，未審能應募否，是不得不借助於撫鎮之兵也。

translations.literal: North of the river famine and drought, Yanxi war and fire—exhausting strength to supply falls short of ten thousand; Henan after ten thousand deaths in one life—whether they can enlist is unknown—so we cannot but borrow from pacification armies.
translations.idiomatic: North of the river famine and drought, Yanxi war and fire—exhausting strength to supply falls short of ten thousand; Henan after ten thousand deaths in one life—whether they can enlist is unknown—so we cannot but borrow from pacification armies.

sentences.zh: 」乃敕兵部速議，而令堪賡刻期興工。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the War Ministry to debate quickly and Kaneng to start work on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the War Ministry to debate quickly and Kaneng to start work on schedule.

sentences.zh: 至四月，塞硃家寨決口，修堤四百餘丈。

translations.literal: By the fourth month Zhujiazhai breach mouth was sealed and dikes repaired for more than four hundred zhang.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourth month the Zhujiazhai breach mouth was sealed and dikes repaired for more than four hundred zhang.

sentences.zh: 馬家口工未就，忽沖東岸，諸埽盡漂沒。

translations.literal: Majiakou work was not finished when it suddenly breached the east bank and all revetments were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Majiakou work was not finished when it suddenly breached the east bank and all revetments were swept away.

sentences.zh: 堪賡請停東岸而專事西岸。

translations.literal: Kaneng asked to stop the east bank and devote effort to the west bank.
translations.idiomatic: Kaneng asked to stop the east bank and devote effort to the west bank.

sentences.zh: 帝令急竣工。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered urgent completion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered urgent completion.

sentences.zh: 六月，堪賡言：「馬家決口百二十丈，兩岸皆築四之一，中間七十餘丈，水深流急，難以措手，請俟霜降後興工。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Kaneng said: "The Majia breach is one hundred twenty zhang; both banks each built one-fourth, the middle seventy-odd zhang water deep and current urgent, hard to work on—we ask to wait until after frost to start work.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Kaneng said: "The Majia breach is one hundred twenty zhang; both banks each built one-fourth, the middle seventy-odd zhang water deep and current urgent, hard to work on—we ask to wait until after frost to start work.

sentences.zh: 」已而言：「五月伏水大漲，故道沙灘壅涸者刷深數丈，河之大勢盡歸於東，運道已通，陵園無恙。

translations.literal: " He then said: "In the fifth month summer flood waters greatly rose; the old channel's sand beach blockage dried and was scoured several zhang deeper; the river's great tendency all turned east, transport was open, and the tombs were unharmed.

translations.literal: The emperor urged laborers; before success was reported the Ming dynasty fell.
